Sentence (English): Have now had the SHP65DM5N dishwasher for several months.
Comments (English): [ Pop! , goes the door. ] || ---------------- || Have now had the SHP65DM5N dishwasher for several months. Does a great job washing the dishes, but the racks are a mixed bag. Really like the top rack ability to hold utensils, a clever design and a real space saver. However, the top rack is difficult to slide out and back in, and the rollers come off the tracks very easily unless you pull it out and push it in exactly centered. The middle rack ability to be adjusted up or down on either or both sides makes it much easier to handle larger items on the middle or bottom racks. The middle rack layout is OK, but just takes some getting used to, as is always the case with a new dishwasher. And the center rack can also be difficult to move, and needs to be pushed in centered and firmly for the wash arm plumbing to seat properly. The bottom rack layout, though, is a disaster, one of those "what were they thinking" moments. While not having a heating element means you can put plastic items anywhere, including the bottom rack, the great distance between some of the ribs in certain areas and the haphazard layout and lack of splines to hold items in some areas makes placing anything but larger pots and pans extremely difficult. The "fold-down" extra splines are very closely spaced (millimeters) with existing ones (and they are only in one area), making them virtually usless. The zone wash in the left rear portion of the bottom of the dishwasher makes it convenient to get larger pots or pans clean, but only if you can fit them over the ackward spline arrangement (this is where large gaps between ribs would be OK, but they are not in that area). The pop-open door at the end of the cycles that is unique on this model almost makes up for the absence of heated drying that is a fact of life in so many modern dishwashers. No matter what you do, though, the dishes will NOT be dry, even with the door open (and we live in an area where the humidity can be single digits in the winter). Sentence (English): We've had the dishwasher for 6 months, and have run 105 loads and I love it.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || We've had the dishwasher for 6 months, and have run 105 loads and I love it. It holds a lot of dishes, it's so quiet, cleaning is excellent (even with little to no pre-rinsing) and dishes come out dry. Sentence (English): I am so disappointed that I purchased this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ The worst dishwasher I've ever owned. ] || ---------------- || I am so disappointed that I purchased this dishwasher. First of all, our dishes smell like cooked plastic after every cycle. I have never had this happen before. As a result, unless I rinse my cup thoroughly in the morning, my coffee tastes like plastic. My second complaint is that the "clean" light only stays on for a few minutes at the end of the wash cycle. The technician, that came out twice, finally found out that this is because of an energy-saving plan that cuts off that little bitty electricy-devouring light. What some tree-hugging design engineer apparently did not consider is that it wastes more energy when my wife unknowingly restarts the washer to rewash dishes that I had cleaned the night before. There is a phone app that the WHOLE HOUSEHOLD could load that would notify everyone about the end of cycle, but this seems impractical. What is also impractical, is that Bosch had to pay a technician to come out twice to figure out the problem. Thirdly, I don't think that the prongs are angled to maximize loading. They are too vertical to allow the loading of bowls on the bottom rack. I am HIGHLY DISSATISFIED with this product.

Wish I purchased something else with a regular filter.

Sentence (English): The baseboards in our apartment are 16cm.

Sentence (English): I was looking for a high-performance dishwasher that wouldn't ruin my kitchen decor, and I purchased the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-place setting because I liked its Grade 1 energy efficiency rating and specifications the most.
Comments (English): I was looking for a high-performance dishwasher that wouldn't ruin my kitchen decor, and I purchased the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-place setting because I liked its Grade 1 energy efficiency rating and specifications the most. It fits perfectly into the sink as a built-in unit, creating a neat look, and the Nature Beige color really brightens up the kitchen. 1. 'Grade 1 Energy' – Worry-free even when using it every day. I was a little worried about electricity bills when buying the dishwasher, but since this model has a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, I was told that running the standard course once costs less than 100 won (about 98 won). Thanks to this, I can comfortably run it every evening without worrying about the cost, even if I only have a small pile of dishes. 2. The majesty of the 14-place setting smart shelf (the knife/scissor holder is the best!). The exterior dimensions are the same as the existing 12-place setting, but the internal space efficiency is insane. In particular, the 'dedicated knife/scissor holder' in the bottom basket is truly a stroke of genius. You can wash items securely fixed in place so they don't roll around dangerously, and the height of the 3-tier shelf is freely adjustable, so even large stockpots or frying pans fit right in. 3. Stain-free water softener & 100°C True Steam. Perhaps due to the water quality in my neighborhood, white water stains used to remain on glass cups after hand washing. However, perhaps because this model is equipped with a water softener, the clear glass cups sparkle like wine bar dishes after the wash is finished. Thanks to the Tornado wash blades and 100°C True Steam, I feel reassured knowing that not only grease but also invisible bacteria are being completely sterilized. 4. Perfect True Drying (Condensation + Automatic Door Opening + Hot Air). Once the wash is finished, the door opens automatically and dries thoroughly with a triple-stage hot air drying process, so there is absolutely no damp feeling when taking items out the next morning. Except for water pooled in the inverted grooves of plastic food containers, the ceramic and glass dishes are completely dry and fluffy. The installation technician was very kind and did a neat job of installing the cabinets, perfectly matching the baseboard height. LG truly is the king of white goods. It is the number one contributor to improving my quality of life!
Comments (Original): 주방 인테리어를 해치지 않으면서도 성능 좋은 식세기를 찾다가, 에너지 1등급에 스펙이 제일 마음에 들어서 LG 디오스 오브제컬렉션 14인용으로 구매했습니다. 싱크대에 빌트인으로 쏙 들어가니까 깔끔하고, 네이처 베이지 컬러가 주방을 정말 화사하게 만들어 주네요.1. 매일 돌려도 부담 없는 '에너지 1등급'식세기 사면서 전기세 걱정을 조금 했는데, 이 모델은 에너지 소비효율 1등급이라 표준코스 1회 돌릴 때 전기료가 100원도 안 나온다(약 98원)고 하더라고요. 덕분에 그릇 조금만 쌓여도 아끼지 않고 매일 저녁 편하게 돌리고 있습니다.2. 14인용 스마트 선반의 위엄 (칼/가위 거치대 최고!)외관 크기는 기존 12인용이랑 똑같은데 내부 공간 효율이 미쳤습니다. 특히 하단 바스켓에 있는 '칼/가위 전용 거치대'가 진짜 신의 한 수예요. 위험하게 굴러다니지 않게 딱 고정해서 씻을 수 있고, 3단 선반 높낮이 조절이 자유로워서 커다란 곰솥이나 프라이팬도 턱턱 들어갑니다.3. 물 얼룩 없는 연수장치 & 100도 트루스팀우리 동네 수질 때문인지 예전엔 손설거지하고 나면 유리컵에 하얗게 물자국이 남았거든요? 근데 이 모델은 연수장치가 탑재되어 있어서 그런지, 세척 끝나고 나면 투명한 유리컵들이 와인바 그릇처럼 반짝반짝 빛이 납니다. 토네이도 세척날개랑 100도 트루스팀 덕분에 기름때는 물론이고 눈에 안 보이는 세균까지 싹 살균되는 기분이라 안심이에요.4. 완벽한 트루 건조 (응축+자동문열림+열풍)세척이 끝나면 알아서 문이 열리면서 열풍 건조까지 3중으로 싹 말려주니까, 다음 날 아침에 꺼낼 때 축축한 느낌이 전혀 없어요. 플라스틱 반찬통 뒤집힌 홈에 고인 물 빼고는 도자기나 유리그릇은 아주 뽀송뽀송합니다.설치 기사님도 걸레받이 높이 딱 맞춰서 깔끔하게 장 공사 작업해 주시고 친절하셨어요. 가전은 역시 백색가전의 왕 LG네요. 삶의 질 향상 1등 공신입니다!

Sentence (English): I used a dishwasher for the first time during our recent move.
Comments (English): I used a dishwasher for the first time during our recent move. Honestly, at first I thought, "How good could doing a little less dishwashing be? My own cleaning is much cleaner." But after using it, I understand why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. Above all, my wife is incredibly satisfied. Freed from the chore of washing dishes several times a day, our evenings have become much more relaxed. We are freed from the stress of doing the dishes after meals and no longer have to worry about when to do them. We now have time to relax or play with the kids while enjoying a cup of coffee. I feel like this isn't just an appliance that does the dishes for us, but one that gives our family back our time. Sentence (English): I used a dishwasher for the first time during this move.
Comments (English): I used a dishwasher for the first time during this move. Honestly, at first I thought, "How good could doing a little less dishwashing be? My own cleaning is cleaner." But after using it, I understand why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. Above all, my wife is incredibly satisfied. Freed from the chore of washing dishes several times a day, our evenings have become much more relaxed. We are freed from the stress of doing dishes after meals and no longer have to worry about when to do them. We now have time to play with the kids or relax while enjoying a cup of coffee. I feel that this isn't just an appliance that does the dishes for us, but one that gives our family back our time. I didn't really understand what it meant for quality of life to improve, but after using a dishwasher, that phrase fits perfectly. As the time spent on housework decreases, my mind feels more at ease, and my daily life feels a bit more fulfilling. Why did I wait so long to buy this lucky charm? Now I understand why people call it "Auntie Dishwasher." I can't imagine life without a dishwasher anymore. It’s just so good! One of the appliances I am most satisfied with from this move is the dishwasher.

However, I concluded that using Miele's automatic detergent dispensing (AutoDos) feature to reduce the hassle of manually adding detergent every time was not worthwhile, as the maintenance costs for their dedicated PowerDisk were higher than those for regular detergent. Since I was going to be adding regular detergent manually anyway, I became convinced that the LG DIOS Objet Collection (DEE6BGE), which focuses entirely on practical hot-air drying and is designed for Korean kitchen environments, was a much more reasonable choice. I purchased it from Coupang. Here is a summary of the advantages I experienced while actually using it. Reasonable price and value for money. Compared to Miele's premium models or mid-range lineups, I was able to save hundreds of thousands of won. The price was much more reasonable, yet it included LG's top-tier features—hot-air drying and 100°C TrueSteam—making it an incomparable and perfect choice in terms of value for money. Accurate and fast Coupang Rocket Installation. Since it is a large appliance, I was most concerned about delivery and installation, but a professional technician visited on the scheduled date. In particular, you accurately identified the specifications of my kitchen's low baseboards (typical of the 10–14cm range for DEE models) and installed it neatly as a built-in unit without the need for complex furniture modifications. The design complements the kitchen interior. Unlike fully built-in European-style units that require custom-made cabinet doors, this product is delivered with the subtle and luxurious Objet Nature Beige panels already finished. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. It is incredibly convenient to be able to take items out and put them away immediately. Being able to check the remaining time and control the unit remotely via the ThinQ app on my smartphone is also very useful. Easy maintenance. Managing the dishwasher's interior is intuitive. The strainer is easy to detach and clean, making it convenient to empty food residue. The app automatically notifies you of the drum sterilization cycle, so you won't have to worry about internal hygiene. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. If you are debating whether to spend a fortune on imported appliances or to enjoy perfect hot-air drying and optimized Korean-style dish storage with practicality, I recommend the LG DEE6BGE. Escape the hell of dishwashing and drastically reduce your housework time. (If my review was helpful, please click 'Helpful' below.)

The design complements the kitchen interior. Unlike fully built-in European-style units that require custom-made cabinet doors, this product is delivered with the subtle and luxurious Objet Nature Beige panels already finished. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. I purchased it from Coupang. Here is a summary of the advantages I experienced while actually using it. Reasonable price and value for money. Compared to Miele's premium models or mid-range lineups, I was able to save hundreds of thousands of won. The price was much more reasonable, yet it included LG's top-tier features—hot-air drying and 100°C TrueSteam—making it an incomparable and perfect choice in terms of value for money. Accurate and fast Coupang Rocket Installation. Since it is a large appliance, I was most concerned about delivery and installation, but a professional technician visited on the scheduled date. In particular, you accurately identified the specifications of my kitchen's low baseboards (typical of the 10–14cm range for DEE models) and installed it neatly as a built-in unit without the need for complex furniture modifications. The design complements the kitchen interior. Unlike fully built-in European-style units that require custom-made cabinet doors, this product is delivered with the subtle and luxurious Objet Nature Beige panels already finished. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. It is incredibly convenient to be able to take items out and put them away immediately. Being able to check the remaining time and control the unit remotely via the ThinQ app on my smartphone is also very useful. Easy maintenance. Managing the dishwasher's interior is intuitive. The strainer is easy to detach and clean, making it convenient to empty food residue. The app automatically notifies you of the drum sterilization cycle, so you won't have to worry about internal hygiene. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. I purchased it from Coupang. Here is a summary of the advantages I experienced while actually using it. Reasonable price and value for money. Compared to Miele's premium models or mid-range lineups, I was able to save hundreds of thousands of won. Accurate and fast Coupang Rocket Installation. Since it is a large appliance, I was most concerned about delivery and installation, but a professional technician visited on the scheduled date. In particular, you accurately identified the specifications of my kitchen's low baseboards (typical of the 10–14cm range for DEE models) and installed it neatly as a built-in unit without the need for complex furniture modifications. The design complements the kitchen interior. Unlike fully built-in European-style units that require custom-made cabinet doors, this product is delivered with the subtle and luxurious Objet Nature Beige panels already finished. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. It is incredibly convenient to be able to take items out and put them away immediately. Being able to check the remaining time and control the unit remotely via the ThinQ app on my smartphone is also very useful. Easy maintenance. Managing the dishwasher's interior is intuitive. The strainer is easy to detach and clean, making it convenient to empty food residue. The app automatically notifies you of the drum sterilization cycle, so you won't have to worry about internal hygiene. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. The strainer is easy to detach and clean, making it convenient to empty food residue. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. Comments (English): [ A review of a product I bought with my own money after comparing it with Millet for a month and finally settling on it. ] || ---------------- || I usually carefully weigh specifications and practicality when buying home appliances, so I initially spent a long time deliberating after adding German Miele products—known as the "king of dishwashers"—to my cart. However, I concluded that using Miele's automatic detergent dispensing (AutoDos) feature to reduce the hassle of manually adding detergent every time was not worthwhile, as the maintenance costs for their dedicated PowerDisk were higher than those for regular detergent. Since I was going to be adding regular detergent manually anyway, I became convinced that the LG DIOS Objet Collection (DEE6BGE), which focuses entirely on practical hot-air drying and is designed for Korean kitchen environments, was a much more reasonable choice. I purchased it from Coupang. Here is a summary of the advantages I experienced while actually using it. Reasonable price and value for money. Compared to Miele's premium models or mid-range lineups, I was able to save hundreds of thousands of won. The price was much more reasonable, yet it included LG's top-tier features—hot-air drying and 100°C TrueSteam—making it an incomparable and perfect choice in terms of value for money. Accurate and fast Coupang Rocket Installation. Since it is a large appliance, I was most concerned about delivery and installation, but a professional technician visited on the scheduled date. In particular, you accurately identified the specifications of my kitchen's low baseboards (typical of the 10–14cm range for DEE models) and installed it neatly as a built-in unit without the need for complex furniture modifications. The design complements the kitchen interior. Unlike fully built-in European-style units that require custom-made cabinet doors, this product is delivered with the subtle and luxurious Objet Nature Beige panels already finished. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. It is incredibly convenient to be able to take items out and put them away immediately. Being able to check the remaining time and control the unit remotely via the ThinQ app on my smartphone is also very useful. Easy maintenance. Managing the dishwasher's interior is intuitive. The strainer is easy to detach and clean, making it convenient to empty food residue. The app automatically notifies you of the drum sterilization cycle, so you won't have to worry about internal hygiene. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. If you are debating whether to spend a fortune on imported appliances or to enjoy perfect hot-air drying and optimized Korean-style dish storage with practicality, I recommend the LG DEE6BGE. I purchased it from Coupang. Here is a summary of the advantages I experienced while actually using it. Reasonable price and value for money. Compared to Miele's premium models or mid-range lineups, I was able to save hundreds of thousands of won. The price was much more reasonable, yet it included LG's top-tier features—hot-air drying and 100°C TrueSteam—making it an incomparable and perfect choice in terms of value for money. Accurate and fast Coupang Rocket Installation. Since it is a large appliance, I was most concerned about delivery and installation, but a professional technician visited on the scheduled date. In particular, you accurately identified the specifications of my kitchen's low baseboards (typical of the 10–14cm range for DEE models) and installed it neatly as a built-in unit without the need for complex furniture modifications. The design complements the kitchen interior. Unlike fully built-in European-style units that require custom-made cabinet doors, this product is delivered with the subtle and luxurious Objet Nature Beige panels already finished. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. It is incredibly convenient to be able to take items out and put them away immediately. Being able to check the remaining time and control the unit remotely via the ThinQ app on my smartphone is also very useful. Easy maintenance. Managing the dishwasher's interior is intuitive. The strainer is easy to detach and clean, making it convenient to empty food residue. The app automatically notifies you of the drum sterilization cycle, so you won't have to worry about internal hygiene. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. Comments (English): [ A review of a product I bought with my own money after comparing it with Millet for a month and finally settling on it. ] || ---------------- || I usually carefully weigh specifications and practicality when buying home appliances, so I initially spent a long time deliberating after adding German Miele products—known as the "king of dishwashers"—to my cart. I purchased it from Coupang. Here is a summary of the advantages I experienced while actually using it. Reasonable price and value for money. Compared to Miele's premium models or mid-range lineups, I was able to save hundreds of thousands of won. The price was much more reasonable, yet it included LG's top-tier features—hot-air drying and 100°C TrueSteam—making it an incomparable and perfect choice in terms of value for money. Accurate and fast Coupang Rocket Installation. Since it is a large appliance, I was most concerned about delivery and installation, but a professional technician visited on the scheduled date. In particular, you accurately identified the specifications of my kitchen's low baseboards (typical of the 10–14cm range for DEE models) and installed it neatly as a built-in unit without the need for complex furniture modifications. The design complements the kitchen interior. Unlike fully built-in European-style units that require custom-made cabinet doors, this product is delivered with the subtle and luxurious Objet Nature Beige panels already finished. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. It is incredibly convenient to be able to take items out and put them away immediately. Being able to check the remaining time and control the unit remotely via the ThinQ app on my smartphone is also very useful. Easy maintenance. Managing the dishwasher's interior is intuitive. The strainer is easy to detach and clean, making it convenient to empty food residue. The app automatically notifies you of the drum sterilization cycle, so you won't have to worry about internal hygiene. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. If you are debating whether to spend a fortune on imported appliances or to enjoy perfect hot-air drying and optimized Korean-style dish storage with practicality, I recommend the LG DEE6BGE. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. Since I was going to be adding regular detergent manually anyway, I became convinced that the LG DIOS Objet Collection (DEE6BGE), which focuses entirely on practical hot-air drying and is designed for Korean kitchen environments, was a much more reasonable choice. I purchased it from Coupang. Here is a summary of the advantages I experienced while actually using it. Reasonable price and value for money. Compared to Miele's premium models or mid-range lineups, I was able to save hundreds of thousands of won. The price was much more reasonable, yet it included LG's top-tier features—hot-air drying and 100°C TrueSteam—making it an incomparable and perfect choice in terms of value for money. Accurate and fast Coupang Rocket Installation. Since it is a large appliance, I was most concerned about delivery and installation, but a professional technician visited on the scheduled date. In particular, you accurately identified the specifications of my kitchen's low baseboards (typical of the 10–14cm range for DEE models) and installed it neatly as a built-in unit without the need for complex furniture modifications. The design complements the kitchen interior. Unlike fully built-in European-style units that require custom-made cabinet doors, this product is delivered with the subtle and luxurious Objet Nature Beige panels already finished. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. It is incredibly convenient to be able to take items out and put them away immediately. Being able to check the remaining time and control the unit remotely via the ThinQ app on my smartphone is also very useful. Easy maintenance. Managing the dishwasher's interior is intuitive. The strainer is easy to detach and clean, making it convenient to empty food residue. The app automatically notifies you of the drum sterilization cycle, so you won't have to worry about internal hygiene. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. If you are debating whether to spend a fortune on imported appliances or to enjoy perfect hot-air drying and optimized Korean-style dish storage with practicality, I recommend the LG DEE6BGE. I purchased it from Coupang. Here is a summary of the advantages I experienced while actually using it. Reasonable price and value for money. Compared to Miele's premium models or mid-range lineups, I was able to save hundreds of thousands of won. The price was much more reasonable, yet it included LG's top-tier features—hot-air drying and 100°C TrueSteam—making it an incomparable and perfect choice in terms of value for money. Accurate and fast Coupang Rocket Installation. Since it is a large appliance, I was most concerned about delivery and installation, but a professional technician visited on the scheduled date. In particular, you accurately identified the specifications of my kitchen's low baseboards (typical of the 10–14cm range for DEE models) and installed it neatly as a built-in unit without the need for complex furniture modifications. The design complements the kitchen interior. Unlike fully built-in European-style units that require custom-made cabinet doors, this product is delivered with the subtle and luxurious Objet Nature Beige panels already finished. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. It is incredibly convenient to be able to take items out and put them away immediately. Being able to check the remaining time and control the unit remotely via the ThinQ app on my smartphone is also very useful. Easy maintenance. Managing the dishwasher's interior is intuitive. The strainer is easy to detach and clean, making it convenient to empty food residue. The app automatically notifies you of the drum sterilization cycle, so you won't have to worry about internal hygiene. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. Comments (English): [ A review of a product I bought with my own money after comparing it with Millet for a month and finally settling on it. ] || ---------------- || I usually carefully weigh specifications and practicality when buying home appliances, so I initially spent a long time deliberating after adding German Miele products—known as the "king of dishwashers"—to my cart. However, I concluded that using Miele's automatic detergent dispensing (AutoDos) feature to reduce the hassle of manually adding detergent every time was not worthwhile, as the maintenance costs for their dedicated PowerDisk were higher than those for regular detergent. Since I was going to be adding regular detergent manually anyway, I became convinced that the LG DIOS Objet Collection (DEE6BGE), which focuses entirely on practical hot-air drying and is designed for Korean kitchen environments, was a much more reasonable choice. I purchased it from Coupang. Here is a summary of the advantages I experienced while actually using it. Reasonable price and value for money. Compared to Miele's premium models or mid-range lineups, I was able to save hundreds of thousands of won. The price was much more reasonable, yet it included LG's top-tier features—hot-air drying and 100°C TrueSteam—making it an incomparable and perfect choice in terms of value for money. Accurate and fast Coupang Rocket Installation. Since it is a large appliance, I was most concerned about delivery and installation, but a professional technician visited on the scheduled date. In particular, you accurately identified the specifications of my kitchen's low baseboards (typical of the 10–14cm range for DEE models) and installed it neatly as a built-in unit without the need for complex furniture modifications. The design complements the kitchen interior. Unlike fully built-in European-style units that require custom-made cabinet doors, this product is delivered with the subtle and luxurious Objet Nature Beige panels already finished. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. It is incredibly convenient to be able to take items out and put them away immediately. Being able to check the remaining time and control the unit remotely via the ThinQ app on my smartphone is also very useful. Easy maintenance. Managing the dishwasher's interior is intuitive. The strainer is easy to detach and clean, making it convenient to empty food residue. The app automatically notifies you of the drum sterilization cycle, so you won't have to worry about internal hygiene. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. If you are debating whether to spend a fortune on imported appliances or to enjoy perfect hot-air drying and optimized Korean-style dish storage with practicality, I recommend the LG DEE6BGE. I purchased it from Coupang. Here is a summary of the advantages I experienced while actually using it. Reasonable price and value for money. Compared to Miele's premium models or mid-range lineups, I was able to save hundreds of thousands of won. The price was much more reasonable, yet it included LG's top-tier features—hot-air drying and 100°C TrueSteam—making it an incomparable and perfect choice in terms of value for money. Accurate and fast Coupang Rocket Installation. Since it is a large appliance, I was most concerned about delivery and installation, but a professional technician visited on the scheduled date. In particular, you accurately identified the specifications of my kitchen's low baseboards (typical of the 10–14cm range for DEE models) and installed it neatly as a built-in unit without the need for complex furniture modifications. The design complements the kitchen interior. Unlike fully built-in European-style units that require custom-made cabinet doors, this product is delivered with the subtle and luxurious Objet Nature Beige panels already finished. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. It is incredibly convenient to be able to take items out and put them away immediately. Being able to check the remaining time and control the unit remotely via the ThinQ app on my smartphone is also very useful. Easy maintenance. Managing the dishwasher's interior is intuitive. The strainer is easy to detach and clean, making it convenient to empty food residue. The app automatically notifies you of the drum sterilization cycle, so you won't have to worry about internal hygiene. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. It is incredibly convenient to be able to take items out and put them away immediately. Being able to check the remaining time and control the unit remotely via the ThinQ app on my smartphone is also very useful. Easy maintenance. Managing the dishwasher's interior is intuitive. The strainer is easy to detach and clean, making it convenient to empty food residue. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. Comments (English): [ A review of a product I bought with my own money after comparing it with Millet for a month and finally settling on it. ] || ---------------- || I usually carefully weigh specifications and practicality when buying home appliances, so I initially spent a long time deliberating after adding German Miele products—known as the "king of dishwashers"—to my cart. However, I concluded that using Miele's automatic detergent dispensing (AutoDos) feature to reduce the hassle of manually adding detergent every time was not worthwhile, as the maintenance costs for their dedicated PowerDisk were higher than those for regular detergent. Since I was going to be adding regular detergent manually anyway, I became convinced that the LG DIOS Objet Collection (DEE6BGE), which focuses entirely on practical hot-air drying and is designed for Korean kitchen environments, was a much more reasonable choice. I purchased it from Coupang. Here is a summary of the advantages I experienced while actually using it. Reasonable price and value for money. Compared to Miele's premium models or mid-range lineups, I was able to save hundreds of thousands of won. The price was much more reasonable, yet it included LG's top-tier features—hot-air drying and 100°C TrueSteam—making it an incomparable and perfect choice in terms of value for money. Accurate and fast Coupang Rocket Installation. Since it is a large appliance, I was most concerned about delivery and installation, but a professional technician visited on the scheduled date. In particular, you accurately identified the specifications of my kitchen's low baseboards (typical of the 10–14cm range for DEE models) and installed it neatly as a built-in unit without the need for complex furniture modifications. The design complements the kitchen interior. Unlike fully built-in European-style units that require custom-made cabinet doors, this product is delivered with the subtle and luxurious Objet Nature Beige panels already finished. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. It is incredibly convenient to be able to take items out and put them away immediately. Being able to check the remaining time and control the unit remotely via the ThinQ app on my smartphone is also very useful. Easy maintenance. Managing the dishwasher's interior is intuitive. The strainer is easy to detach and clean, making it convenient to empty food residue. The app automatically notifies you of the drum sterilization cycle, so you won't have to worry about internal hygiene. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. If you are debating whether to spend a fortune on imported appliances or to enjoy perfect hot-air drying and optimized Korean-style dish storage with practicality, I recommend the LG DEE6BGE. Comments (English): [ A review of a product I bought with my own money after comparing it with Millet for a month and finally settling on it. ] || ---------------- || I usually carefully weigh specifications and practicality when buying home appliances, so I initially spent a long time deliberating after adding German Miele products—known as the "king of dishwashers"—to my cart. Since I was going to be adding regular detergent manually anyway, I became convinced that the LG DIOS Objet Collection (DEE6BGE), which focuses entirely on practical hot-air drying and is designed for Korean kitchen environments, was a much more reasonable choice. I purchased it from Coupang. Here is a summary of the advantages I experienced while actually using it. Reasonable price and value for money. Compared to Miele's premium models or mid-range lineups, I was able to save hundreds of thousands of won. The price was much more reasonable, yet it included LG's top-tier features—hot-air drying and 100°C TrueSteam—making it an incomparable and perfect choice in terms of value for money. Accurate and fast Coupang Rocket Installation. Since it is a large appliance, I was most concerned about delivery and installation, but a professional technician visited on the scheduled date. In particular, you accurately identified the specifications of my kitchen's low baseboards (typical of the 10–14cm range for DEE models) and installed it neatly as a built-in unit without the need for complex furniture modifications. The design complements the kitchen interior. Unlike fully built-in European-style units that require custom-made cabinet doors, this product is delivered with the subtle and luxurious Objet Nature Beige panels already finished. It blends seamlessly with my kitchen's tone, making the entire space look much cleaner and more spacious. The cleaning performance and the convenience of ThinQ app integration are excellent. Thanks to the 100° TrueSteam function, even greasy frying pans left over after grilling meat are cleaned perfectly without the need for pre-washing. The noise level is also incredibly quiet, quiet enough to leave running overnight. The most satisfying feature is the hot air drying function; unlike appliances that rely on natural drying, it forcibly blows hot air into the door once it opens, thoroughly drying even the moisture that collects in the rims of plastic food containers. It is incredibly convenient to be able to take items out and put them away immediately. Being able to check the remaining time and control the unit remotely via the ThinQ app on my smartphone is also very useful. Easy maintenance. Managing the dishwasher's interior is intuitive. The strainer is easy to detach and clean, making it convenient to empty food residue. The app automatically notifies you of the drum sterilization cycle, so you won't have to worry about internal hygiene. Since you can use cost-effective tablet detergents available on the market instead of expensive dedicated detergents, there is absolutely no stress regarding maintenance costs. Overall review. Comments (English): [ I can't go back to a life without a dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || When it was just my husband and me living together, there wasn't much to wash, so I never even considered a dishwasher. But raising a child has made the pile of dishes so heavy and exhausting. Childcare alone makes the day feel short, and with bottles and baby food containers piling up, I felt like I was wasting every moment standing around doing the dishes every day. Since Samsung was running a promotion recently, I finally decided to get a 6-place setting dishwasher after much consideration, and I think this is what it truly means for one's "quality of life" to change. First off, since I can just pre-wash and press a button, I can rest a little or do other things during that time. I love that it fits perfectly in our small kitchen. Most importantly, because it sterilizes thoroughly with much hotter water than when washing by hand, I feel much more at ease managing my child's dishes. Of course, the interior isn't very spacious enough to fit pots or large frying pans all at once, so you still need to pre-wash them to lightly shake off food residue before putting them in. Still, I can't express how happy I am that I don't have to wrestle with piles of dishes like I used to. I wish I had bought this sooner. If you're like me and overwhelmed by the dishes while raising a child, a dishwasher is an absolute must. Thanks to it, my evenings have become much more relaxed these days, so I'm really satisfied with it. Dishwasher, you're the best!

Sentence (English): I was looking for a high-performance dishwasher that wouldn't ruin my kitchen decor, and I purchased the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-place setting because I liked its Grade 1 energy efficiency rating and specifications the most.
Comments (English): I was looking for a high-performance dishwasher that wouldn't ruin my kitchen decor, and I purchased the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-place setting because I liked its Grade 1 energy efficiency rating and specifications the most. It fits perfectly into the sink as a built-in unit, creating a neat look, and the Nature Beige color really brightens up the kitchen. 1. 'Grade 1 Energy' – Worthwhile to use every day. I was a little worried about electricity bills when buying the dishwasher, but since this model has a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, I was told that running the standard course once costs less than 100 won (about 98 won). Thanks to this, I can comfortably run it every evening without worrying about the cost, even if I only have a small pile of dishes. 2. The majesty of the 14-place setting smart shelf (the knife/scissor holder is the best!). The exterior dimensions are the same as the existing 12-place setting, but the internal space efficiency is insane. In particular, the dedicated knife/scissor holder in the bottom basket is truly a stroke of genius. You can wash items securely fixed in place so they don't roll around dangerously, and the height of the 3-tier shelf is freely adjustable, so even large stockpots or frying pans fit right in. 3. Stain-free water softener & 100°C True Steam. Perhaps due to the water quality in my neighborhood, white water stains used to remain on glass cups after hand washing. However, perhaps because this model is equipped with a water softener, the clear glass cups sparkle like wine bar dishes after the wash is finished. Thanks to the Tornado washing blades and 100°C True Steam, I feel reassured knowing that not only grease but also invisible bacteria are being completely sterilized. 4. Perfect True Drying (Condensation + Automatic Door Opening + Hot Air). Once the wash is finished, the door opens automatically and dries thoroughly with a triple-stage hot air drying process, so there is absolutely no damp feeling when taking items out the next morning. Except for water pooled in the inverted grooves of plastic food containers, the ceramic and glass dishes are completely dry and fluffy. The installation technician was very kind and did a neat job of installing the cabinets, perfectly matching the baseboard height. LG truly is the king of white goods. It is the number one contributor to improving my quality of life!

It fits perfectly into the sink as a built-in unit, creating a neat look, and the Nature Beige color really brightens up the kitchen. 1. 'Grade 1 Energy' – Worthwhile to use every day. I was a little worried about electricity bills when buying the dishwasher, but since this model has a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, I was told that running the standard course once costs less than 100 won (about 98 won). Thanks to this, I can comfortably run it every evening without worrying about the cost, even if I only have a small pile of dishes. 2. The majesty of the 14-place setting smart shelf (the knife/scissor holder is the best!). The exterior dimensions are the same as the existing 12-place setting, but the internal space efficiency is insane. In particular, the dedicated knife/scissor holder in the bottom basket is truly a stroke of genius. You can wash items securely fixed in place so they don't roll around dangerously, and the height of the 3-tier shelf is freely adjustable, so even large stockpots or frying pans fit right in. 3. Stain-free water softener & 100°C True Steam. Perhaps due to the water quality in my neighborhood, white water stains used to remain on glass cups after hand washing. However, perhaps because this model is equipped with a water softener, the clear glass cups sparkle like wine bar dishes after the wash is finished. Thanks to the Tornado washing blades and 100°C True Steam, I feel reassured knowing that not only grease but also invisible bacteria are being completely sterilized. 4. Perfect True Drying (Condensation + Automatic Door Opening + Hot Air). Once the wash is finished, the door opens automatically and dries thoroughly with a triple-stage hot air drying process, so there is absolutely no damp feeling when taking items out the next morning. Except for water pooled in the inverted grooves of plastic food containers, the ceramic and glass dishes are completely dry and fluffy. The installation technician was very kind and did a neat job of installing the cabinets, perfectly matching the baseboard height. LG truly is the king of white goods. It is the number one contributor to improving my quality of life!

Sentence (English): I finally made the big decision to purchase the LG Dios Objet 14-place setting dishwasher (DUE6BGL1E), and as soon as it was installed, I was experiencing firsthand why everyone says a dishwasher is a must-have.
Comments (English): [ 14-place setting + Grade 1 + Ultimate hot air dryer, truly satisfied~~ ] || ---------------- || I finally made the big decision to purchase the LG Dios Objet 14-place setting dishwasher (DUE6BGL1E), and as soon as it was installed, I was experiencing firsthand why everyone says a dishwasher is a must-have. What I like most is definitely the overwhelming capacity of the 14-place setting model. The exterior dimensions are the same as the previous 12-place setting model, so it doesn't take up extra kitchen space, but the interior offers incredible space efficiency thanks to the smart shelf system. Even after filling it with plenty of rice and soup bowls, deep and large pots, pans, and cooking utensils all fit in at once, so I can finish everything in one go without having to let the dishes pile up, which is incredibly satisfying. Also, the decisive reason I chose this model was its Grade 1 energy efficiency rating and the hot air drying function. It is great to be able to run it every day without worrying about electricity bills, and above all, the hot air drying feature that activates automatically after the door opens following the wash cycle is amazing. I saw reviews saying that with conventional dishwashers, moisture would condense on the rims of plastic containers, requiring them to be shaken off to dry. However, this product dries everything with hot air as if baking, so dishes come out fluffy and dry without a single water stain—good enough to put directly into the cupboard. Thanks to the Tornado Wash and 100° True Steam, even stubborn grease and burnt-on sauces are cleaned much more thoroughly than hand washing, leaving everything squeaky clean! Being from the Objet Collection line, it blends perfectly with my kitchen decor, and the built-in fit is sleek and precise. I was satisfied with every step of the process, from delivery to the friendly technician's installation. I will make good use of this! Oh, and since my cabinet is non-standard size, the cost for the remodeling—including cutting and shortening the electrical wires—came out to 172,000 won.
Comments (Original): [ 14인용 + 1등급 + 열풍건조 끝판왕, 진짜 대만족~~ ] || ---------------- || 이번에 큰맘 먹고 LG 디오스 오브제 식기세척기 14인용(DUE6BGL1E)으로 구매했는데, 설치하자마자 왜 다들 식세기는 필수라고 하는지 온몸으로 체감하고 있습니다.가장 마음에 드는 건 역시 14인용의 압도적인 용량입니다. 외관 사이즈는 기존 12인용이랑 똑같아서 주방 자리를 더 차지하지 않는데, 내부는 스마트 선반 시스템 덕분에 공간 효율이 엄청 좋습니다. 밥그릇, 국그릇 잔뜩 넣고도 깊고 큰 냄비나 프라이팬, 조리기구까지 한 번에 다 들어가니까 설거지거리 모아둘 필요 없이 한 방에 끝낼 수 있어서 너무 속이 시원합니다.그리고 이 모델을 선택한 결정적인 이유가 에너지 소비효율 1등급에 열풍건조 기능이 있어서였는데요. 전기세 부담 없이 매일 돌릴 수 있어서 좋고, 무엇보다 세척 끝난 뒤 자동 문 열림 후에 작동하는 열풍건조가 대박입니다. 기존 식세기들은 플라스틱 용기 테두리에 물기가 맺혀서 털어 말려야 한다는 후기를 봤는데, 이 제품은 뜨거운 바람으로 싹 구워주듯이 말려주니까 물얼룩 하나 없이 뽀송뽀송하게 나와서 바로 찬장에 넣어도 될 정도입니다. 토네이도 세척에 100도 트루스팀 덕분에 기름때나 양념 눌어붙은 것도 손설거지보다 훨씬 깨끗하고 뽀드득하게 닦이네요!!오브제컬렉션 라인이라 주방 인테리어와도 완벽하게 어우러지고 빌트인 핏도 깔끔하게 딱 떨어집니다. 배송부터 친절한 기사님 설치까지 모든 과정이 만족스러웠습니다. 정말 잘 쓰겠습니다!아 저는 장이 비규격장이라서 리폼하는데 전기선도 따고 줄이고 해서 17만2천원 나왔습니다.

Sentence (English): The most satisfying aspects of using the LG DIOS Objet Collection 14-place setting built-in dishwasher at the daycare center are its cleaning power and hygiene.
Comments (English): [ Bravo, my life ] || ---------------- || The most satisfying aspects of using the LG DIOS Objet Collection 14-place setting built-in dishwasher at the daycare center are its cleaning power and hygiene. At the daycare, we have to wash a large number of trays and stainless steel dishes multiple times a day; relying solely on hand washing was time-consuming and limited in terms of hygiene management. However, after installing this product, our work became much easier as we could load a generous amount of trays at once. As shown in the photo, even when placing multiple stainless steel daycare trays at once, the space utilization was excellent, allowing us to organize and stack them neatly. We were also very satisfied that almost no food stains or grease remained after washing. Since hygiene is paramount for tableware used by children, the high-temperature washing and drying functions are major advantages, allowing us to use the product with peace of mind. The drying performance also exceeded expectations. After washing, there were minimal water stains and the trays dried cleanly, allowing us to tidy up immediately or prepare for the next meal, which saved us time. Stainless steel trays are prone to water stains, but we are highly satisfied that they are kept much cleaner than before. Furthermore, the quiet operation allowed us to use it without any issues in a daycare environment where children spend their time. I was very satisfied that it did not significantly disturb us during nap times or classes, and the ability to select various washing cycles according to the situation made it convenient to wash not only trays but also cups, cutlery, and serving dishes together. The interior basket was sturdily constructed, providing stability even when multiple heavy stainless steel trays were placed inside, and the water flow reached the trays well, resulting in excellent cleaning power. The time spent on daily dishwashing has been significantly reduced, easing the workload for teachers, and I am even more satisfied because the time saved allows us to spend more time with the children. The professional technician carried out the installation process meticulously and kindly explained how to use it, and the design in Nature Beige also blended well with the atmosphere of the daycare kitchen. Since this product satisfies in terms of functionality, cleaning power, hygiene, and convenience, I believe it is a dishwasher that can be fully appreciated not only by daycare centers, kindergartens, and food service facilities that need to wash large quantities of dishes daily, but also by households. I plan to continue using it for a long time to maintain a hygienic food service environment, and I confidently recommend this product to any place that handles a lot of tray washing. I highly, highly recommend it. As expected, LG is the best for home appliances. I hope my review was helpful. If it was, please press the 'Helpful' button.

One side constantly comes off the track making it impossible to get it back in when rack is even partially full. The other frustration we are having is the detergent door does not deploy consistently so the cycle runs without utilizing any detergent or its halfway dispensed and half sitting on dishes. Filing a warranty claim which is very frustrating at this price point. Writing this review to hopefully keep others from going through this same frustration. We have a lower end Bosch in our rental and it works flawlessly even though the lower rack track is lower quality.

Comments (English): [ Design flaw caused leaking and reduced performance ] || ---------------- || Poor design that can lead to leaks and reduced performanceI am very disappointed with the GE GDP670SYV1FS dishwasher. GE needs to address the root cause instead of reducing functionality to work around the problem.

Sentence (English): I've had dishwashers since I was 10.
Comments (English): [ OMG ] || ---------------- || I've had dishwashers since I was 10. I'm now 76 and have been through a bunch of them. They all worked the same basically. I would rinse the dishes, put them into the machine and run it. It was time for a new dishwasher and I was going crazy choosing one this time around. Reading reiew after review etc. Finally fed up, I decided go with this simply because ratings said it was the best out there. Well, it IS. I followed the instructions and did NOT rinse the dirty dishes. I just put the into the machine UNRINSED and put it on the "AUTO" setting and let it run. EVERYTHING is CLEAN with NO RINSING. I will not use Rinse Aid and I use only detergents pods that are rated as safe on the EWG. So, the dished and glassed DO come out with some water drops here and there on the "NORMAL" dry cycle. That's ok for me. There IS a "Sanitize" cycle that really dries them and a "Chrystal Dry" dry cycle that leaves them spotless, bug again, I don't need that and would rather save energy and the life of the machine. One star off for the pathetic wifi nonsense that must be used for certain functions like a "Rinse Only" Cycle. That said, this is the BEST Dishwasher I have ever owned. Cleans dirty UNRINSED dishes with caked on gook perfectly. EXTREMELY quiet. I love that I can use it with "SAFE" detergents and NO Rinse Aid. VERY happy with this purchase,

Sentence (English): Poor design that can lead to leaks and reduced performance.
Comments (English): [ Design flaw caused leaking and reduced performance ] || ---------------- || Poor design that can lead to leaks and reduced performance. I am very disappointed with the GE GDP670SYV1FS dishwasher. After normal use, the bottom spray arm began resting against the heating element, which melted and warped the plastic underside of the spray arm. The damaged spray arm then caused water to spray incorrectly, resulting in water leaking out of the front door and onto the floor. What makes this more frustrating is that GE previously used a simple metal guard on the underside of the spray arm to prevent this issue. Instead of keeping that proven solution, GE's redesign appears to raise the spray arm and lower dish rack and reduce the heating element wattage. The result is less usable loading space and weaker drying performance. A dishwasher should not have a design that allows a plastic component to melt during normal operation and potentially cause water damage. GE needs to address the root cause instead of reducing functionality to work around the problem.

GE needs to address the root cause instead of reducing functionality to work around the problem.

Sentence (English): Cheaply made dishwasher door is extremely flimsy.
Comments (English): Cheaply made dishwasher door is extremely flimsy. Pretty quiet but no top strip for aesthetics and to muffle noise. Cleans dishes ok but not well on quick wash cycle. Top tray is a bonus but then makes for non-ergonomic bending to place glasses in 2nd level. Overall, cheaper build and quality than I expected for the price. Should have bought Bosch. Delivery and scheduled install with HD contract company was a nightmare. Two delivery guys didn't want to work on a Saturday. First said our hot water valve was stuck (then I turned it with 2 fingers). And finally said they could not install because “valve leaked and needs to be replaced.” Left dishwasher in the dining room. I was so aggravated with their excuses that I called HD, canceled install and fought for a refund (that I am still battling 2 months later). Hired a plumber to install and valve did NOT need to be replaced. Total ripoff with HD contracted company and HD should get rid of them. It's no wonder why we were their 5th stop and they arrived at 8am (started at 7)! Hire companies that actually want to work and won't leave customers in a bind!

Sentence (English): LG DIOS Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher Purchase Review.
Comments (English): LG DIOS Objet Collection Built-in Dishwasher Purchase Review. The LG DIOS Objet Collection built-in dishwasher was one of the appliances I was most looking forward to during my kitchen remodel. I used a product from another brand for 10 years, and compared to that, the difference is like night and day. The most satisfying aspect is the cleaning power. In particular, thanks to the 100% True Steam function, there are fewer water stains, and glass cups and stainless steel dishes are finished cleanly, delivering results that are even more satisfying than hand washing. The drying performance was also excellent. I liked that the door opens automatically after the wash is finished to effectively release internal moisture, leaving dishes fluffy and no odors lingering. When I washed a kimchi container, the kimchi smell did disappear significantly. Storage was also more convenient than expected. It features a smart shelf structure designed for efficient arrangement of plates, pots, pans, and cups, allowing me to load a large quantity of dishes without any burden. I was very satisfied with the capacity, which is sufficient even for a full family meal run in one go. The design is also sleek, as expected from the Objet Collection. Installing it as a built-in unit allowed it to blend naturally with the sink, making the kitchen look much wider and more luxurious. I also liked that the simple front design matches well with any interior style. It is also quite quiet, so I didn't have to worry too much even when washing at night. I used the All-in-One True Wash detergent, but adding rinse aid made the clothes feel even squeaky clean.

Sentence (English): An honest review after one month of using the dishwasher.
Comments (English): An honest review after one month of using the dishwasher. At first, I wondered if I really needed it, but now it is my number one essential appliance. The biggest advantage I’ve noticed is definitely the time saving. The 20 to 30 minutes I used to spend doing dishes every day have completely disappeared, and being able to rest or do other things during that time has dramatically improved my quality of life. I can definitely feel the difference, especially when washing greasy foods or pots. The cleaning power is also much better than I expected. It feels like they clean more thoroughly than when washing by hand, and glass cups and dishes finish squeaky clean without any water stains. Since it uses high-temperature washing, I am also satisfied with the hygiene aspect. The noise is quieter than I feared, so I didn't mind running it at night. Comments (English): An honest review after one month of using the dishwasher. At first, I wondered if I really needed it, but now it is my number one essential appliance. The biggest advantage I’ve noticed is definitely saving time. The 20 to 30 minutes I used to spend washing dishes every day has completely disappeared, and being able to rest or do other things during that time has dramatically improved my quality of life. I can definitely feel the difference, especially when washing greasy foods or pots. The cleaning power is also much better than I expected. It feels like they wash more thoroughly than when I washed them by hand, and glass cups and dishes finish squeaky clean without any water stains. Since it uses high-temperature washing, I am also satisfied with the hygiene aspect. The noise is quieter than I feared, so I didn't mind running it at night. I was initially worried about water usage and electricity costs, but after actually using it, it feels more efficient than washing by hand. To sum it up, it is an appliance I am so satisfied with that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. I highly recommend it to dual-income couples or anyone stressed about washing dishes.

Sentence (English): I checked the dimensions before purchasing.
Comments (English): [ Installation is not possible if there is even 1 centimeter of space missing from the sink. ] || ---------------- || I checked the dimensions before purchasing. Since our sink isn't very big and we already have a water purifier, frontal installation was impossible. For side installation, it was about 2 centimeters short, resulting in it sticking out toward the sink. So, before buying on Coupang, I visited an offline store to look at it and asked an employee. They told me that sticking out by about 2 centimeters wasn't a problem, so I went ahead and bought it. However, when the Samsung installation technician arrived and looked at it, he said it wouldn't work. He said installation is absolutely impossible if there isn't enough space, and that it would only be possible if I purchased an auxiliary kitchen countertop. So, I hurriedly ordered a custom-made 10-centimeter auxiliary countertop online for just over 30,000 won. Make sure to check the dimensions carefully before purchasing, and if you need more space, buy a sink extension countertop in advance! The dishwasher door shouldn't get in the way of the drying rack or kitchen faucet on the sink when opening. In our house, there was a drying rack hanging above the sink, but it got in the way when opening the door, so we removed it. Also, I had previously installed and used it under an Ovx 14-place setting dishwasher at my old house, and naturally... Since it is a 6-person capacity, the size is small, so you have to work harder at Tetris to fit everything together. Also, while this product has an automatic door opening function, it lacks a hot air drying function, so some moisture remains. However, if you run it after dinner and clean up the next morning, all the moisture is completely dry. In our house, the kitchen faucet is located above the sink, so installation was possible without drilling a drain hole in the countertop. Installation took less than 30 minutes. Although it is advertised as a 6-person capacity, it seems to actually fit about 3 people. If you cut a Pro-X detergent in half and put it in, it cleans well without leaving grease stains. It is a shame that it lacks a hot air drying function, but it is still great for working moms as it saves time.

Sentence (English): As a family of five with three children, I was under immense stress due to the "dishwashing bomb" that piled up the moment we finished a meal.
Comments (English): As a family of five with three children, I was under immense stress due to the "dishwashing bomb" that piled up the moment we finished a meal. I finally made the big decision to switch to the Samsung Bespoke 14-place setting model, and my quality of life has skyrocketed to the point where I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner! 1. Overwhelmingly large capacity perfectly suited for a family of three. While the size is similar to the previous 12-place setting, the interior space is much more efficiently organized. It fits children's plates, cups, snack bowls, and even pots and pans all at once. It feels so satisfying to be able to finish everything in one go after dinner without having to run multiple cycles. 2. Powerful sterilization and cleaning power that eliminates the need for a separate bottle sterilizer. Since the dishes are used by children, hygiene was my top priority, but the high-temperature direct water sterilization function gives me peace of mind. Even greasy frying pans or burnt-on rice come out sparkling clean, even if I just do a quick pre-wash before putting them in. 3. Bespoke design that enhances the kitchen atmosphere. Design is truly key when it comes to home appliances. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen decor like custom-made furniture without ruining the interior, making me feel good every time I look at it. It is really quiet, so running it late at night is not a burden at all. Overall review: It is a grateful appliance that allows me to make eye contact with my children one more time during dishwashing hours and have some time to myself after my parenting duties are over. If you have a multi-child household, hesitation will only delay delivery; I unconditionally recommend the large-capacity 14-place setting model!

Sentence (English): After much deliberation, I finally bought a dishwasher.
Comments (English): After much deliberation, I finally bought a dishwasher. Why did I wait so long to purchase it? After returning to work following the birth of my second child, I realized that the time spent doing the dishes after work was much longer than I had anticipated, as I had to take care of the kids and do housework. I thought that if I could just reduce that time, I could spend more time playing with my children, so after much consideration, I purchased the LG DIOS dishwasher. Pros: Dishwashing time is drastically reduced. Since I spend less time standing in front of the sink after work, the time I spend with my children has increased significantly. I am truly satisfied with the cleaning power. Even greasy dishes are cleaned thoroughly, and there are almost no water stains, so it feels even cleaner than hand washing. My quality of life has changed. Since it finishes automatically just by pressing a button, my daily routine has become much more relaxed. The noise is also quieter than I expected. It doesn't bother me much even when I run it after the kids are asleep, so I can use it without any worries. The built-in design makes the kitchen look neat. It blends well with the kitchen interior, which further increases my satisfaction. Cons: I hesitated a lot before buying it because of the price. It was a burden at first, but after using it, I am so satisfied that I regret the time I spent hesitating. Overall Review. This is an appliance I highly recommend to working moms or families raising children. Being freed from the chores of washing dishes has made me feel much more relaxed both physically and mentally, and I am most satisfied that I can spend more time with my kids. It is the first appliance that made me think, "Why did I wait so long to buy this?" I hope my review, based on my own purchase, is helpful to you.

Sentence (English): I had been debating whether to buy a dishwasher for a while, but I finally made the purchase and am using it with such satisfaction that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner.
Comments (English): I had been debating whether to buy a dishwasher for a while, but I finally made the purchase and am using it with such satisfaction that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. Since we are a household of three, I was worried that a 6-place setting might be too small, but the storage is better than I expected; it fits dishes from a single meal quite easily. Being able to organize plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, as well as cups and cutlery all at once has really reduced my dishwashing stress. Above all, the cleaning power exceeded my expectations! Even greasy plates and dishes with sauce stains were cleaned thoroughly, so I rarely had to wash them by hand. Water stains weren't severe, and glass cups were washed clear, so I am satisfied every time I use it. I was worried that installing a countertop model might be complicated, but it was surprisingly easy to use and didn't take up much kitchen space. I also liked that the Bespoke design blends well with the kitchen's atmosphere so it doesn't detract from the interior. The clean design makes the kitchen feel much more organized. The operating noise is also quieter than I expected, so I didn't mind running it in the evening. I think the biggest advantage is being able to just put the dishes in after a meal, press the button, and leave it running while doing other housework or taking a break. My quality of life has definitely improved, especially on busy days, because I no longer have to put off washing dishes! As I have a baby at home, I am very conscious of hygiene; since it washes at a higher temperature than hand washing, I feel at ease, and I am highly satisfied because I can keep my cups and tableware clean. It also seems to use less water than I expected, so I use it frequently without any burden. I hesitated at first because of the price, but after using it myself, I am fully satisfied with the product. It reduces the time spent on daily dishwashing and eases the strain on my wrists, so I am using it very effectively. I am satisfied with the design, cleaning power, and ease of use, so I would like to recommend this product to anyone considering buying a dishwasher.

But then I realized that washing dishes isn't as easy a task as I thought; it's actually moderate-intensity labor. It's so good, and if you rinse and put it in right after eating, it washes and dries automatically, so it feels squeaky clean, just like it was pre-washed. The technicians are super friendly too.
