Sentence (English): A year ago, when we were setting up our new home, I didn't buy a dishwasher because I wondered if we really needed one.
Comments (English): A year ago, when we were setting up our new home, I didn't buy a dishwasher because I wondered if we really needed one. But now that I'm actually using it, I wonder why I didn't get one sooner. My husband and I would have argued less if we had. Since we both work, we were tired after work, so we would often put off washing dishes. It used to be so stressful whenever I saw the piles of dishes, but now I am free from that stress. Now, if there are only a few dishes, I gather them up and run the wash cycle all at once. If you set it to AI wash, it automatically adjusts the time and number of washes based on the amount of dishes. My wrists are usually weak and used to hurt often if I washed dishes for a long time, but now the strain on my wrists has decreased, and I am very satisfied because I can use that time to organize the kitchen. Basic dishes, cups, and cutlery were washed very thoroughly, and I really like that the door opens automatically. Also, I dry them on a drying rack one more time. Since it even supports a sterilization function, I feel like I made the right purchase at the right time as an expectant mom. However, I did notice that very fine stains were sometimes left on greasy pots or pans, so I had to rinse them one more time; but considering my overall satisfaction, it wasn't a significant inconvenience. I was worried that it might look unnatural if the color didn't match the sink, but once it was finished, it didn't look unnatural at all. Comments (English): A year ago, when we were setting up our new home, I didn't buy a dishwasher because I wondered if we really needed one. If you set it to AI wash, it automatically adjusts the time and number of washes based on the amount of dishes. My wrists are usually weak and used to hurt often if I washed dishes for a long time, but now the strain on my wrists has decreased, and I am very satisfied because I can use that time to organize the kitchen. Basic dishes, cups, and cutlery were washed very thoroughly, and I really like that the door opens automatically. Also, I dry them on a drying rack one more time. Since it even supports a sterilization function, I feel like I made the right purchase at the right time as an expectant mom. However, I did notice that very fine stains were sometimes left on greasy pots or pans, so I had to rinse them one more time; but considering my overall satisfaction, it wasn't a significant inconvenience. I was worried that it might look unnatural if the color didn't match the sink, but once it was finished, it didn't look unnatural at all. Lastly, the technician came first to refurbish the sink, followed by the installation technician; even though they have a high volume of orders these days, they quickly coordinated the date and time. I was very satisfied with the installation, as they were kind and helpful. The design also blends naturally with the kitchen, so I am very happy with it.

Since we both work, we were tired after work, so we would often put off washing dishes. It used to be so stressful whenever I saw the piles of dishes, but now I am free from that stress. Now, if there are only a few dishes, I gather them up and run the wash cycle all at once. If you set it to AI wash, it automatically adjusts the time and number of washes based on the amount of dishes. My wrists are usually weak and used to hurt often if I washed dishes for a long time, but now the strain on my wrists has decreased, and I am very satisfied because I can use that time to organize the kitchen. Basic dishes, cups, and cutlery were washed very thoroughly, and I really like that the door opens automatically. Also, I dry them on a drying rack one more time. Since it even supports a sterilization function, I feel like I made the right purchase at the right time as an expectant mom. However, I did notice that very fine stains were sometimes left on greasy pots or pans, so I had to rinse them one more time; but considering my overall satisfaction, it wasn't a significant inconvenience. I was worried that it might look unnatural if the color didn't match the sink, but once it was finished, it didn't look unnatural at all. Lastly, the technician came first to refurbish the sink, followed by the installation technician; even though they have a high volume of orders these days, they quickly coordinated the date and time. I was very satisfied with the installation, as they were kind and helpful. The design also blends naturally with the kitchen, so I am very happy with it.

Sentence (English): If you're looking for a no-frills dishwasher that simply gets the job done, this one delivers.
Comments (English): [ Not Fancy but Does the Job! ] || ---------------- || If you're looking for a no-frills dishwasher that simply gets the job done, this one delivers. It cleans consistently and reliably — which, at the end of the day, is what matters most. That said, if features are important to you, may need to pay a little more. This model offers only a handful of wash cycles, and the top rack adjusts similarly to oven racks — you have to remove it completely to move it up or down. Unlike other dishwashers that have those convenient adjustment levers on the sides, this one doesn't, so repositioning the rack is a bit more of a process. Not a dealbreaker for everyone, but worth knowing upfront. It's also louder than I anticipated, which a few other reviewers mentioned as well. For my situation — a rental apartment with a closed-off kitchen well away from the bedroom — it's a non-issue. But if you have an open floor plan or a noise-sensitive household, factor that in. For context, my parents recently installed an LG QuadWash model and the difference in noise level is noticeable. Costco also carried a comparable model at a similar price point (now sold out) that was rated at lower decibels — I would have preferred that one had it still been available. Bottom line: a reliable workhorse for the price, especially if features and quiet operation aren't priorities. --- INSTALLATION — Five Stars and Then Some A huge shoutout to our installer, Alex. We're in an older high-rise in Chicago, where logistics are rarely straightforward. Alex showed up on time, navigated a very tight space efficiently, and was genuinely pleasant throughout. We even got an earlier appointment thanks to a cancellation — a nice bonus. I'll admit, some of the reviews about installation had me nervous going in, but our experience couldn't have been smoother. It's also worth noting that Costco keeps things simple: one flat price covers the appliance, installation, and haul-away. No surprises.

Sentence (English): On the whole, this gets the job done and dishes are clean.
Comments (English): [ A Frustrating Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || On the whole, this gets the job done and dishes are clean. Drying is average and much worse than my old dishwasher was on a one hour wash. Beyond that, there are a few things that are very frustrating that I feel compelled to call out. And it's worth noting that this review is being written after having owned the dishwasher for about three months, plenty of time to adjust to the differences from my old dishwasher. The first major point of frustration is the overall positioning of the tines in each of the racks and even the spacing of bars in certain positions in the bottom rack in particular. It seems like a small thing but the incredibly large gaps in the bottom rack mean that many of the most natural positions for bowls make them sit too low below the rack when tilted on their side to the point where it seems the spray arm might actually hit it. But even if it didn't, the position of bowls on their side is slightly tipped back which can result in water collecting in the bowl. So I am forced to use more space and put the bowl completly upside down. As for the tines, after three months of using this, I find myself constantly moving things around post-load because I don't have a clear sense of my "go to" spots for many of my most commonly used dishes. Obviously everyone's dishes are different but I've never had this experience with other dishwashers I've used for this long. The second major frustration is the interface buttons. They are not responsive (there's a second delay after touching them and every time I have a brief moment of thinking, "Did I tap it right? ", often hitting the button again only to realize I've undone my first touch). Not only that, but many of the labels are unclear. The reason for this seems largely because the dishwasher is "smart" - and is nudging you to use the phone app for many common functions. For example, "Want to run the dishwasher on a delay? Use the app! " The trouble is, this is so much more annoying (dare I say "dumber") than simply tapping a delay button on the panel. When my hands are wet from washing dishes, I don't want to have to look for my phone, open an app, select an appliance, and set a time. Does doing so give me the ability to be more precise with my delayed start time? Sure. Does that make it better than a quick button tap allowing me to set a 2/4/6 hour delay? Absolutely not. It's super annoying. This is just one example of what I don't like about the buttons (or lack thereof) and the app but it's representative of the overall experience. The only thing I like about this dishwasher is that the middle rack (there is a thin top rack for silverware) has three height adjustments. This makes it flexible for putting taller items - e.g. a tall stemmed wine glass - in the top shelf if you want. I do like that. I'm sad to say it but I would never purchase this dishwasher again and would want an in-person inspection first before purchasing any other Bosch diswasher.

Sentence (English): The first thing I was impressed by after having it installed as a built-in unit in the sink was the design.
Comments (English): The first thing I was impressed by after having it installed as a built-in unit in the sink was the design. The clean and sophisticated Essential White color fits perfectly with the kitchen cabinets, looking as if it were custom-made furniture, making the kitchen atmosphere brighter and more luxurious. In particular, the 'Hidden Touch' structure, where the controls are concealed on the top surface rather than the front of the door, makes the exterior look very minimal and clean. Since it becomes a completely smooth flat surface when the door is closed, it will provide great visual satisfaction for those who prioritize kitchen interiors. Furthermore, choosing the large 14-place setting was a stroke of genius. While the exterior dimensions are the same as the existing 12-place model, the internal storage space has been efficiently expanded to accommodate a much larger quantity of dishes. It features a three-tier shelf structure, and the top section is convenient for organizing cutlery, knives, and cooking utensils side by side without overlapping. The middle and bottom baskets have generous spacing between the plate racks and are freely adjustable in height, allowing you to arrange large frying pans, stockpots, and wide children's plates—items that were usually the most bothersome to wash by hand—all at once. Thanks to this, even on days when I cook a lot, I can finish the dishes all at once without having to divide them up and run the washing machine multiple times, which has drastically reduced the time spent on housework.

Sentence (English): I was planning to buy a Miele dishwasher, but I ended up making a rush purchase because of the Samsung Onnuri promotion, a Naver event, and even a card discount.
Comments (English): I was planning to buy a Miele dishwasher, but I ended up making a rush purchase because of the Samsung Onnuri promotion, a Naver event, and even a card discount. It was a shame that the price kept fluctuating. Delivery was fast considering the high volume of orders, but I had to exchange it due to a unit defect. The seller was kind during the consultation and processed the matter quickly. The start wasn't exactly pleasant, but the technician who refurbished the base cabinet was very kind, and the dishwasher installation was decent. I suppose it couldn't be helped since the machine is heavy, but the flooring got scratched while taking the dishes out and putting them back in, which makes me upset every time I see it. It has a 3-tier configuration and includes a wine rack. I ran a small load quick cycle for a test run, but I'm not sure if it dries properly. Even when I ran the standard cycle, water was so excessive that a whole bucketful poured out, and I had to leave the door open until the next day to wait for it to dry. Even if it isn't completely dry, the drying performance is still very disappointing. I don't eat out often, but I get a lot of dishes on weekends, and there's a lot of dishwashing when guests come over, so I won't use it frequently, but I think it will definitely make things more convenient!

Sentence (English): This is a review after 3 months of use.
Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance.
Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.
