Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ You might not realize how inconvenient it is without it, but having it dramatically improves your quality of life! ] || ---------------- || This is a review after 3 months of use. My quality of life has truly changed. [Pros]. First off, paying 300,000 won for dishwasher installation is a real bargain. The technician called the day before, so as long as I explained my situation, they took care of everything, which is a definite plus right from the start. I was someone who debated whether or not to buy a dishwasher for almost a year. I used to think, "I can just wash dishes by hand," but once I actually used it, I immediately understood why everyone calls a dishwasher an essential appliance. I have been using it almost every day for about 3 months now, and to start with the conclusion, I regret not buying this sooner. I use it at least 2 to 3 times a day, and the stress of having to do the dishes after every meal has almost completely disappeared. In the past, I hated seeing dishes pile up in the sink after eating, so I had to wash them right away. Now, it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and press a button. I was most curious about the cleaning power at first, but it was much more satisfying than I expected. Not only soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery, but even frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly if you just soak most food residue in them slightly. I was surprised that even greasy dishes were cleaned until they were squeaky clean, and that glass cups and stainless steel items became much shinier than when washing by hand. The drying function is also quite satisfying. Since most dishes are nearly dry after washing, I can simply take them out and organize them immediately, and I feel reassured knowing that hygiene is being maintained. It feels even more hygienic, especially since I don't have to wipe them with a dishcloth. The noise level is also surprisingly quiet. The first time I used it, I even had to step right up to check if it was running. It doesn't interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations, and I didn't mind running it at night. I was worried that the 6-person capacity might be too small, but after actually using it, I found the capacity is sufficient for a family of 2 to 4 people. Once you get used to arranging the dishes, it holds much more than you might expect. Since I can fit rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all in one go, cleaning up after meals has become incredibly fast. What I particularly like is that it saves me time. I think I save about 30 minutes of dishwashing time every day. A day may seem short, but if you consider it over three months, it amounts to a tremendous amount of time saved. I think the biggest advantage is being able to rest or do other things after a meal instead of doing the dishes. Water usage is lower than expected, so I actually felt it was more economical than washing by hand. It doesn't require much detergent, and maintenance is not difficult. Since you only need to take out the filter occasionally to rinse it, upkeep was simple. The exterior features a clean white design that doesn't detract from the kitchen interior and actually gives it a cleaner look. The buttons are intuitive, so my parents learned how to use it quickly, and anyone can use it easily as you just need to select the desired course without any complicated settings. The biggest thing I noticed while using it for three months is that dishwashing has disappeared from my household chores. In the past, I sometimes ordered delivery because washing dishes was a hassle rather than eating out, but now the burden of cooking at home has been significantly reduced. When guests come over, cleaning up is also really convenient because I can just put all the dishes in at once and run the cycle. I have been using it with great satisfaction so far without any breakdowns or errors, and I think the performance is excellent for the price. At this price point, installation is included, and I am satisfied with the washing power, drying performance, and ease of use, so I felt it offers excellent value for money. [Disadvantages] First of all, the biggest issue for me—and this isn't a product defect—is that it is smaller than I expected for a family of five. On days when we eat Western food, we generate a lot of dishes, so having to run the cycle twice is a bit inconvenient. However, this isn't a product defect; it's my fault for buying the smaller model. Also, it doesn't have a drying function, which I found a bit disappointing. Aside from that, I am so satisfied that I am recommending it to everyone around me. [Overall Review] To summarize, I believe this product is not simply an appliance that does the dishwashing for you, but a 'quality-of-life appliance' that reduces the time spent on housework. If you are considering buying one, I recommend purchasing it as soon as possible. Even if I had to choose again, I would 100% repurchase this product and actively recommend it to those around me. During the three months I have used it, the conveniences far outweighed the inconveniences, and I am using it with such satisfaction that it is now hard to imagine life without a dishwasher.

Sentence (English): We have been using this dishwasher for about 2 months now.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 800 Series ] || ---------------- || We have been using this dishwasher for about 2 months now. It cleans and dries the dishes very well, is extremely quiet. I have never had a dishwasher that does better. With that being said, all four of my kids (9-16 years old) keep on telling me they like our old Samsung dishwasher better. Granted, we didn't call customer service right away or look at the manual. We had the hardest time getting it to turn on and begin the cycle. The buttons are not intuitive for my kids and I. I didn't realize that there is an app to operate it. After using the app, it is incredibly impressive what customization is possible, as well as instructional videos. My kids love turning it on using the app. My kids still don't like the amount of room inside the dishwasher and the layout the items have to be in. The other dishwasher we had seemed to hold more. They had no idea that our old dishwasher was not as nice of quality - they just gave me their honest opinions. My opinion is that I'd buy it again.

Sentence (English): It offers great value for money.
Comments (English): It offers great value for money. I'm someone who usually prefers washing dishes by hand, so I wondered what extra features a dishwasher really needs. That's why I just looked for a cheap one. I initially ordered from Coupang, but after waiting two weeks, they suddenly said they were out of stock. So I canceled the order and chose LG instead. It was such a great choice! It matches my kitchen perfectly, and the color is a perfect match for the sink. Also, I barely run it once a day right now, but it fits plenty of dishes for a family of five for a single meal. I was worried the 12-place setting might be too small, but it fits comfortably. It has a separate cutlery holder, and the cutlery washes well. The technician was so kind and made sure the balance was perfectly adjusted before leaving!

Sentence (English): A delivery driver visited within a week of placing the order and kindly installed it.
Comments (English): A delivery driver visited within a week of placing the order and kindly installed it. However, after installation, I noticed that all buttons except the power button were unresponsive. The driver personally requested an exchange, so I left the unit installed and waited again. I requested the exchange on Saturday, but received no contact regarding whether the request had been processed by the following Wednesday. On Wednesday afternoon, I called the Samsung.com Customer Center to confirm the exchange. They told me that since the exchange was handled by the logistics center, they couldn't verify it directly and would check and contact me later. I waited, and they contacted me the next day confirming that a visit was scheduled. As someone who works during the week, I was quite flustered to be told the delivery would be the next day without any prior communication. The installation technician contacted me later, replaced the unit with a new one the following day, and the installation went smoothly. I was quite disappointed that the exchange process was not smooth, rather than the product itself. Since many people buy Samsung products because of their excellent service, this aspect was a bit of a letdown. I haven't used the dishwasher yet, but it is a bit of a shame that it seems to lack a separate drying function. However, I like that it can be used efficiently in a small space. I will use it more.

Sentence (English): After hesitating for ages, I finally brought in a helper.
Comments (English): After hesitating for ages, I finally brought in a helper. I heard rumors about Samsung Payback and made the payment immediately on the launch day. Thanks to that, I was able to receive the delivery on the scheduled date. The technician who came to repair the sink visited early in the morning and removed the cabinets really neatly, and the dishwasher was delivered in the afternoon. They worked incredibly fast and even cleaned everything thoroughly, so I naturally thought, "This is Samsung." Since the dishwasher has a large capacity, I don't run it every day. Because I have to pay extra for detergent, I just hand-wash small dishes and only run it on weekends when I cook a lot. It removes grease completely, which is great. I also have baby items, so I tried running the high-temperature sterilization cycle once, and the plastic dishes, like the side dish bowls, were perfectly fine without any deformation! However, rice grains or dried-on food residue don't come off easily, so you definitely need to pre-wash them to remove them before running the cycle. The downside is that since it's automatic, it opens way too easily just by leaning against it. I'm slightly regretting that I didn't just buy a manual one.

Comments (English): [ Seemed like a good unit but, wait ] || ---------------- || We purchased this unit almost a year ago. It functions well, in general. His take was that the inner shell was damaged at assembly. The tensioner slipped, due to this. He was able to fix that. However, it seems to be failing quickly. This isn't the quality I expect from Samsung products, and I remain a big supporter. However, I can't recommend this one.

Coming from a KitchenAid that lasted 15 years we are not familiar with all the new features in a dishwasher. Our main requirement is that it would be very quiet when running, plus do a good job cleaning the dishes. This washer is very quiet, and we are happy with that. It also seems to clean well, though we tend to rinse of the dishes before loading so it's not really dealing with a difficult situation. Drying also seems to be decent. The bottom rack is set up a bit weirdly where the middle area is not all that useful. Instead of getting 3 rows of dishes in, we now can get only 2. I wish there was an option to eliminate the top utensil rack and raise the 2nd rack a bit so that larger cooking sheets and other items fit better in the bottom rack. As mentioned and other reviews the racks also are not 'smooth' when pulling out or pushing back in. The washer will work, it's very quiet and seems to do its job. We'll get used to the lower capacity. Hopefully we won't need a new one for another 10+ years.

I accept one bad unit because of a failed set of parts run. The same issues both times? That's a bad design. This is completely ridiculous, and now we may have to wait additional months when we find a different machine that works for us and can be delivered and installed up here.This machine is featured for ADA with the expense to go behind it. I understand that planned failure is a thing in today's market because everyone wants higher profits, but essentially paying $450/yr for a residential dishwasher is ridiculous. They need to last 7-10 years.LG this is unacceptable. You need to do better.

Sentence (English): I rarely write negative reviews, but after spending $1,500 on a supposedly high-end dishwasher that never worked properly and ultimately failed in just 3½ years—with no meaningful support from the manufacturer—I feel compelled to warn others considering this purchase.
Comments (English): [ Not Worth the Price, Horrible Customer Service ] || ---------------- || I rarely write negative reviews, but after spending $1,500 on a supposedly high-end dishwasher that never worked properly and ultimately failed in just 3½ years—with no meaningful support from the manufacturer—I feel compelled to warn others considering this purchase. Here's what happened:. ● I purchased the unit in late 2022 for about $1,500, including installation, expecting a high-end appliance. ● Within just a few weeks, I noticed serious drying issues. Even with the Extra Dry setting, dishes were consistently coming out wet. ● I scheduled a service appointment and took time off work, but the technician's solution was simply to give me a sample of Jet-Dry rinse aid rather than conduct what I felt was a thorough evaluation of a nearly new appliance. ● Even after that, the dishwasher never performed the way I expected from a premium appliance, and the drying problems I reported at the outset were never truly resolved. ● After only about 3 years, the dishwasher failed. ● I paid $360 for a technician to spend 15 minutes to tell me that the unit is junk—a complete write-off—and that repairs would cost $1,400. ● Bosch's customer service was unresponsive and obstructive. Despite documenting the drying problems within weeks of purchase, they made it nearly impossible to escalate my concerns—repeatedly deflecting, offering no meaningful assistance, and focusing only on warranty limitations instead of addressing what was clearly an ongoing issue from the start. For perspective, the $300 GE dishwasher this Bosch replaced lasted approximately 18 years with virtually no issues. I expected premium quality and premium customer service. Unfortunately, I experienced neither.

Comments (English): [ An item that dramatically improves quality of life! My absolute favorite household item! ] || ---------------- || Before using a dishwasher, the pile of dishes accumulating after every meal was a real burden, but since using the Samsung BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher, washing dishes is no longer a chore! The most satisfying aspect is definitely being freed from dishwashing. Since I can wash rice bowls, soup bowls, plates, cups, and cutlery all at once, the time spent washing dishes after meals has been significantly reduced. I thought it would be small since it is a 6-place setting model, but it is more spacious than I expected, easily accommodating enough dishes for a family of 3 to 4 for a single meal. The cleaning performance was also better than expected. Even greasy plates and dishes with broth stains were cleaned thoroughly, and I felt that the dishes were cleaner and more hygienic than when washing by hand. In particular, with the high-temperature direct water wash and 99.999% sterilization functions, I think households using baby bottles or children's tableware can use it with peace of mind! Personally, the feature I liked the most was the automatic door opening drying function. Once the wash is finished, the door opens automatically to naturally release internal moisture; thanks to this, there were fewer water stains and almost no musty odors. It was convenient not having to leave the door open separately, and the drying performance was satisfactory. True to the Bespoke style, the design was clean and luxurious, matching well with the kitchen interior. As an appliance used daily, I was even more pleased to be satisfied with both the performance and the design. Advantages: Dishwashing liberation. Everyday tableware such as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, and cutlery can be washed all at once. Reduced burden of washing dishes after meals frees up extra time. Significantly reduced frequency of hand washing. Ample storage space. Although it is a 6-place setting, the interior space is more spacious than expected. It can easily store tableware for a single meal for a family of 3 to 4. Dishes, cups, and cutlery can be organized and stacked efficiently. Automatic door opening drying. The door opens automatically after the wash cycle is finished to support natural drying. More hygienic as it reduces internal moisture and odors. Minimal water stains and easy maintenance. Hygienic high-temperature washing. Cleanly removes grease and food residue with high-temperature direct water washing. Supports 99.999% sterilization function. Peace of mind for households using baby bottles or children's tableware. Clean Bespoke design. The white color blends naturally with the kitchen interior. As a countertop model, it maximizes space efficiency. It features a simple yet luxurious design. It operates quietly. The noise level is not high even during operation, making it comfortable to use late at night or in the evening. Overall review: To sum it up, I was highly satisfied with this product because it reduces dishwashing time and offers hygienic cleaning and convenient drying functions. After using it, I truly understood why dishwashers are called "quality-of-life appliances"!

The cleaning performance was also better than expected. Even greasy plates and dishes with broth stains were cleaned thoroughly, and I felt that the dishes were cleaner and more hygienic than when washing by hand. In particular, with the high-temperature direct water wash and 99.999% sterilization functions, I think households using baby bottles or children's tableware can use it with peace of mind! Personally, the feature I liked the most was the automatic door opening drying function. Once the wash is finished, the door opens automatically to naturally release internal moisture; thanks to this, there were fewer water stains and almost no musty odors. It was convenient not having to leave the door open separately, and the drying performance was satisfactory. True to the Bespoke style, the design was clean and luxurious, matching well with the kitchen interior. As an appliance used daily, I was even more pleased to be satisfied with both the performance and the design. Advantages: Dishwashing liberation. Everyday tableware such as rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, and cutlery can be washed all at once. Reduced burden of washing dishes after meals frees up extra time. Significantly reduced frequency of hand washing. Ample storage space. Although it is a 6-place setting, the interior space is more spacious than expected. It can easily store tableware for a single meal for a family of 3 to 4. Dishes, cups, and cutlery can be organized and stacked efficiently. Automatic door opening drying. The door opens automatically after the wash cycle is finished to support natural drying. More hygienic as it reduces internal moisture and odors. Minimal water stains and easy maintenance. Hygienic high-temperature washing. Cleanly removes grease and food residue with high-temperature direct water washing. Supports 99.999% sterilization function. Peace of mind for households using baby bottles or children's tableware. Clean Bespoke design. The white color blends naturally with the kitchen interior. As a countertop model, it maximizes space efficiency. It features a simple yet luxurious design. It operates quietly. The noise level is not high even during operation, making it comfortable to use late at night or in the evening. Overall review: To sum it up, I was highly satisfied with this product because it reduces dishwashing time and offers hygienic cleaning and convenient drying functions. After using it, I truly understood why dishwashers are called "quality-of-life appliances"!

'고온살균', '헹굼추가', '강력건조' 등 다양한 옵션을 직관적으로 선택할 수 있습니다. 특히 요즘 같은 시기에 젖병이나 아이 식기를 99.9% 살균해 주는 고온 살균 기능은 정말 안심이 됩니다.세척이 끝나면 자동으로 문이 열리는 '자동 문 열림 건조' 기능 덕분에 내부 습기와 냄새 걱정 없이 식기를 뽀송뽀송하게 건조할 수 있는 점도 큰 장점입니다. 에너지 소비 효율 1등급이라 전기세 부담도 덜었어요.3. 사용 팁 & 마무리: 전용 세제 필수 & SmartThings 활용식기세척기의 성능을 제대로 느끼려면 전용 세제를 사용하는 것이 중요합니다. 린스를 함께 사용하면 건조 성능이 훨씬 좋아지고 물 얼룩도 예방할 수 있습니다. 그리고 삼성 SmartThings 앱을 연결하면 외부에서도 세척 상태를 확인하거나 코스를 다운로드할 수 있어 훨씬 편리하게 사용할 수 있습니다.4. 총평:디자인, 성능, 편리함까지 뭐 하나 빠지는 게 없는 제품입니다. 설거지 시간을 줄여 가족과 함께하는 시간을 늘리고 싶은 분들께 강력히 추천합니다. 삼성 비스포크 식기세척기, 정말 후회 없는 선택이 될 것입니다!

A genuine review of the Samsung Bespoke 14-place setting dishwasher, purchased with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I finally installed the dishwasher I've been singing the praises of! After much deliberation, I chose the new Samsung BESPOKE 14-place setting built-in model (DW80H73Y1UZ). To start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. I hope my review helps those who are still deciding. 1. Pros: The Finishing Touch to Kitchen Interior & Perfect Cleaning Power The first thing that catches my eye is the design. Installed as a built-in unit to match my white kitchen, it looks incredibly clean. It fits in so snugly like custom-made furniture that it doesn't detract from the interior but rather adds a sophisticated touch. The soft mood lighting is also luxurious. Needless to say, the cleaning power is exceptional. Even without pre-washing, it washes away grease stains completely. (Check out the spacious interior and detailed wash guides!) Since it is a 14-place setting, large dishes like pots and pans fit comfortably, making it incredibly convenient. I feel liberated from the hell of dishwashing! 2. Key Features: Convenient Touch Controls & High-Temperature Sterilization The control panel is hidden at the top of the door via a touch interface, giving it a truly sleek appearance. You can intuitively select various options such as 'High Temperature Sterilization,' 'Extra Rinse,' and 'Powerful Drying.' Especially in times like these, the High Temperature Sterilization function, which sterilizes baby bottles and children's tableware by 99.9%, provides true peace of mind. Another major advantage is the 'Automatic Door Opening Drying' feature, which automatically opens the door after washing is finished, allowing you to dry dishes thoroughly without worrying about internal moisture or odors. With a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills has also been reduced. 3. Usage Tips & Finale: Dedicated Detergent Essential & Utilize SmartThings. To fully experience the dishwasher's performance, it is important to use the dedicated detergent. Using rinse aid along with it significantly improves drying performance and helps prevent water stains. Additionally, connecting the Samsung SmartThings app allows you to check the wash status or download cycles from outside, making it much more convenient to use. 4. Overall Review: This product lacks nothing in terms of design, performance, and convenience. I highly recommend it to those who want to reduce dishwashing time and increase time with their families. The Samsung BESPOKE Dishwasher will be a choice you truly won't regret!

A genuine review of the Samsung Bespoke 14-place setting dishwasher, purchased with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I finally installed the dishwasher I've been singing the praises of! After much deliberation, I chose the new Samsung BESPOKE 14-place setting built-in model (DW80H73Y1UZ). To start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. I hope my review helps those who are still deciding. 1. Pros: The Finishing Touch to Kitchen Interior & Perfect Cleaning Power The first thing that catches my eye is the design. Installed as a built-in unit to match my white kitchen, it looks incredibly clean. It fits in so snugly like custom-made furniture that it doesn't detract from the interior but rather adds a sophisticated touch. The soft mood lighting is also luxurious. Needless to say, the cleaning power is exceptional. Even without pre-washing, it washes away grease stains completely. (Check out the spacious interior and detailed wash guides!) Since it is a 14-place setting, large dishes like pots and pans fit comfortably, making it incredibly convenient. I feel liberated from the hell of dishwashing! 2. Key Features: Convenient Touch Controls & High-Temperature Sterilization The control panel is hidden at the top of the door via a touch interface, giving it a truly sleek appearance. You can intuitively select various options such as 'High Temperature Sterilization,' 'Extra Rinse,' and 'Powerful Drying.' Especially in times like these, the High Temperature Sterilization function, which sterilizes baby bottles and children's tableware by 99.9%, provides true peace of mind. Another major advantage is the 'Automatic Door Opening Drying' feature, which automatically opens the door after washing is finished, allowing you to dry dishes thoroughly without worrying about internal moisture or odors. With a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills has also been reduced. 3. Usage Tips & Finale: Dedicated Detergent Essential & Utilize SmartThings. To fully experience the dishwasher's performance, it is important to use the dedicated detergent. Using rinse aid along with it significantly improves drying performance and helps prevent water stains. Additionally, connecting the Samsung SmartThings app allows you to check the wash status or download cycles from outside, making it much more convenient to use. 4. Overall Review: This product lacks nothing in terms of design, performance, and convenience. I highly recommend it to those who want to reduce dishwashing time and increase time with their families. The Samsung BESPOKE Dishwasher will be a choice you truly won't regret!

After much deliberation, I chose the new Samsung BESPOKE 14-place setting built-in model (DW80H73Y1UZ). To start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. I hope my review helps those who are still deciding. 1. Pros: The Finishing Touch to Kitchen Interior & Perfect Cleaning Power The first thing that catches my eye is the design. Installed as a built-in unit to match my white kitchen, it looks incredibly clean. It fits in so snugly like custom-made furniture that it doesn't detract from the interior but rather adds a sophisticated touch. The soft mood lighting is also luxurious. Needless to say, the cleaning power is exceptional. Even without pre-washing, it washes away grease stains completely. (Check out the spacious interior and detailed wash guides!) Since it is a 14-place setting, large dishes like pots and pans fit comfortably, making it incredibly convenient. I feel liberated from the hell of dishwashing! 2. Key Features: Convenient Touch Controls & High-Temperature Sterilization The control panel is hidden at the top of the door via a touch interface, giving it a truly sleek appearance. You can intuitively select various options such as 'High Temperature Sterilization,' 'Extra Rinse,' and 'Powerful Drying.' Especially in times like these, the High Temperature Sterilization function, which sterilizes baby bottles and children's tableware by 99.9%, provides true peace of mind. Another major advantage is the 'Automatic Door Opening Drying' feature, which automatically opens the door after washing is finished, allowing you to dry dishes thoroughly without worrying about internal moisture or odors. With a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills has also been reduced. 3. Usage Tips & Finale: Dedicated Detergent Essential & Utilize SmartThings. To fully experience the dishwasher's performance, it is important to use the dedicated detergent. Using rinse aid along with it significantly improves drying performance and helps prevent water stains. Additionally, connecting the Samsung SmartThings app allows you to check the wash status or download cycles from outside, making it much more convenient to use. 4. Overall Review: This product lacks nothing in terms of design, performance, and convenience. I highly recommend it to those who want to reduce dishwashing time and increase time with their families. The Samsung BESPOKE Dishwasher will be a choice you truly won't regret!

After much deliberation, I chose the new Samsung BESPOKE 14-place setting built-in model (DW80H73Y1UZ). To start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. I hope my review helps those who are still deciding. 1. Pros: The Finishing Touch to Kitchen Interior & Perfect Cleaning Power The first thing that catches my eye is the design. Installed as a built-in unit to match my white kitchen, it looks incredibly clean. It fits in so snugly like custom-made furniture that it doesn't detract from the interior but rather adds a sophisticated touch. The soft mood lighting is also luxurious. Needless to say, the cleaning power is exceptional. Even without pre-washing, it washes away grease stains completely. (Check out the spacious interior and detailed wash guides!) Since it is a 14-place setting, large dishes like pots and pans fit comfortably, making it incredibly convenient. I feel liberated from the hell of dishwashing! 2. Key Features: Convenient Touch Controls & High-Temperature Sterilization The control panel is hidden at the top of the door via a touch interface, giving it a truly sleek appearance. You can intuitively select various options such as 'High Temperature Sterilization,' 'Extra Rinse,' and 'Powerful Drying.' Especially in times like these, the High Temperature Sterilization function, which sterilizes baby bottles and children's tableware by 99.9%, provides true peace of mind. Another major advantage is the 'Automatic Door Opening Drying' feature, which automatically opens the door after washing is finished, allowing you to dry dishes thoroughly without worrying about internal moisture or odors. With a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills has also been reduced. 3. Usage Tips & Finale: Dedicated Detergent Essential & Utilize SmartThings. To fully experience the dishwasher's performance, it is important to use the dedicated detergent. Using rinse aid along with it significantly improves drying performance and helps prevent water stains. Additionally, connecting the Samsung SmartThings app allows you to check the wash status or download cycles from outside, making it much more convenient to use. 4. Overall Review: This product lacks nothing in terms of design, performance, and convenience. I highly recommend it to those who want to reduce dishwashing time and increase time with their families. The Samsung BESPOKE Dishwasher will be a choice you truly won't regret!

A genuine review of the Samsung Bespoke 14-place setting dishwasher, purchased with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I finally installed the dishwasher I've been singing the praises of! After much deliberation, I chose the new Samsung BESPOKE 14-place setting built-in model (DW80H73Y1UZ). To start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. I hope my review helps those who are still deciding. 1. Pros: The Finishing Touch to Kitchen Interior & Perfect Cleaning Power The first thing that catches my eye is the design. Installed as a built-in unit to match my white kitchen, it looks incredibly clean. It fits in so snugly like custom-made furniture that it doesn't detract from the interior but rather adds a sophisticated touch. The soft mood lighting is also luxurious. Needless to say, the cleaning power is exceptional. Even without pre-washing, it washes away grease stains completely. (Check out the spacious interior and detailed wash guides!) Since it is a 14-place setting, large dishes like pots and pans fit comfortably, making it incredibly convenient. I feel liberated from the hell of dishwashing! 2. Key Features: Convenient Touch Controls & High-Temperature Sterilization The control panel is hidden at the top of the door via a touch interface, giving it a truly sleek appearance. You can intuitively select various options such as 'High Temperature Sterilization,' 'Extra Rinse,' and 'Powerful Drying.' Especially in times like these, the High Temperature Sterilization function, which sterilizes baby bottles and children's tableware by 99.9%, provides true peace of mind. Another major advantage is the 'Automatic Door Opening Drying' feature, which automatically opens the door after washing is finished, allowing you to dry dishes thoroughly without worrying about internal moisture or odors. With a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills has also been reduced. 3. Usage Tips & Finale: Dedicated Detergent Essential & Utilize SmartThings. To fully experience the dishwasher's performance, it is important to use the dedicated detergent. Using rinse aid along with it significantly improves drying performance and helps prevent water stains. Additionally, connecting the Samsung SmartThings app allows you to check the wash status or download cycles from outside, making it much more convenient to use. 4. Overall Review: This product lacks nothing in terms of design, performance, and convenience. I highly recommend it to those who want to reduce dishwashing time and increase time with their families. The Samsung BESPOKE Dishwasher will be a choice you truly won't regret!

A genuine review of the Samsung Bespoke 14-place setting dishwasher, purchased with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I finally installed the dishwasher I've been singing the praises of! After much deliberation, I chose the new Samsung BESPOKE 14-place setting built-in model (DW80H73Y1UZ). To start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. I hope my review helps those who are still deciding. 1. Pros: The Finishing Touch to Kitchen Interior & Perfect Cleaning Power The first thing that catches my eye is the design. Installed as a built-in unit to match my white kitchen, it looks incredibly clean. It fits in so snugly like custom-made furniture that it doesn't detract from the interior but rather adds a sophisticated touch. The soft mood lighting is also luxurious. Needless to say, the cleaning power is exceptional. Even without pre-washing, it washes away grease stains completely. (Check out the spacious interior and detailed wash guides!) Since it is a 14-place setting, large dishes like pots and pans fit comfortably, making it incredibly convenient. I feel liberated from the hell of dishwashing! 2. Key Features: Convenient Touch Controls & High-Temperature Sterilization The control panel is hidden at the top of the door via a touch interface, giving it a truly sleek appearance. You can intuitively select various options such as 'High Temperature Sterilization,' 'Extra Rinse,' and 'Powerful Drying.' Especially in times like these, the High Temperature Sterilization function, which sterilizes baby bottles and children's tableware by 99.9%, provides true peace of mind. Another major advantage is the 'Automatic Door Opening Drying' feature, which automatically opens the door after washing is finished, allowing you to dry dishes thoroughly without worrying about internal moisture or odors. With a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills has also been reduced. 3. Usage Tips & Finale: Dedicated Detergent Essential & Utilize SmartThings. To fully experience the dishwasher's performance, it is important to use the dedicated detergent. Using rinse aid along with it significantly improves drying performance and helps prevent water stains. Additionally, connecting the Samsung SmartThings app allows you to check the wash status or download cycles from outside, making it much more convenient to use. 4. Overall Review: This product lacks nothing in terms of design, performance, and convenience. I highly recommend it to those who want to reduce dishwashing time and increase time with their families. The Samsung BESPOKE Dishwasher will be a choice you truly won't regret!

Needless to say, the cleaning power is exceptional. Even without pre-washing, it washes away grease stains completely. (Check out the spacious interior and detailed wash guides!) Since it is a 14-place setting, large dishes like pots and pans fit comfortably, making it incredibly convenient. I feel liberated from the hell of dishwashing! 2. Key Features: Convenient Touch Controls & High-Temperature Sterilization The control panel is hidden at the top of the door via a touch interface, giving it a truly sleek appearance. You can intuitively select various options such as 'High Temperature Sterilization,' 'Extra Rinse,' and 'Powerful Drying.' Especially in times like these, the High Temperature Sterilization function, which sterilizes baby bottles and children's tableware by 99.9%, provides true peace of mind. Another major advantage is the 'Automatic Door Opening Drying' feature, which automatically opens the door after washing is finished, allowing you to dry dishes thoroughly without worrying about internal moisture or odors. With a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills has also been reduced. 3. Usage Tips & Finale: Dedicated Detergent Essential & Utilize SmartThings. To fully experience the dishwasher's performance, it is important to use the dedicated detergent. Using rinse aid along with it significantly improves drying performance and helps prevent water stains. Additionally, connecting the Samsung SmartThings app allows you to check the wash status or download cycles from outside, making it much more convenient to use. 4. Overall Review: This product lacks nothing in terms of design, performance, and convenience. I highly recommend it to those who want to reduce dishwashing time and increase time with their families. The Samsung BESPOKE Dishwasher will be a choice you truly won't regret!

A genuine review of the Samsung Bespoke 14-place setting dishwasher, purchased with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I finally installed the dishwasher I've been singing the praises of! After much deliberation, I chose the new Samsung BESPOKE 14-place setting built-in model (DW80H73Y1UZ). To start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. I hope my review helps those who are still deciding. 1. Pros: The Finishing Touch to Kitchen Interior & Perfect Cleaning Power The first thing that catches my eye is the design. Installed as a built-in unit to match my white kitchen, it looks incredibly clean. It fits in so snugly like custom-made furniture that it doesn't detract from the interior but rather adds a sophisticated touch. The soft mood lighting is also luxurious. Needless to say, the cleaning power is exceptional. Even without pre-washing, it washes away grease stains completely. (Check out the spacious interior and detailed wash guides!) Since it is a 14-place setting, large dishes like pots and pans fit comfortably, making it incredibly convenient. I feel liberated from the hell of dishwashing! 2. Key Features: Convenient Touch Controls & High-Temperature Sterilization The control panel is hidden at the top of the door via a touch interface, giving it a truly sleek appearance. You can intuitively select various options such as 'High Temperature Sterilization,' 'Extra Rinse,' and 'Powerful Drying.' Especially in times like these, the High Temperature Sterilization function, which sterilizes baby bottles and children's tableware by 99.9%, provides true peace of mind. Another major advantage is the 'Automatic Door Opening Drying' feature, which automatically opens the door after washing is finished, allowing you to dry dishes thoroughly without worrying about internal moisture or odors. With a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills has also been reduced. 3. Usage Tips & Finale: Dedicated Detergent Essential & Utilize SmartThings. To fully experience the dishwasher's performance, it is important to use the dedicated detergent. Using rinse aid along with it significantly improves drying performance and helps prevent water stains. Additionally, connecting the Samsung SmartThings app allows you to check the wash status or download cycles from outside, making it much more convenient to use. 4. Overall Review: This product lacks nothing in terms of design, performance, and convenience. I highly recommend it to those who want to reduce dishwashing time and increase time with their families. The Samsung BESPOKE Dishwasher will be a choice you truly won't regret!

Installed as a built-in unit to match my white kitchen, it looks incredibly clean. It fits in so snugly like custom-made furniture that it doesn't detract from the interior but rather adds a sophisticated touch. The soft mood lighting is also luxurious. Needless to say, the cleaning power is exceptional. Even without pre-washing, it washes away grease stains completely. (Check out the spacious interior and detailed wash guides!) Since it is a 14-place setting, large dishes like pots and pans fit comfortably, making it incredibly convenient. I feel liberated from the hell of dishwashing! 2. Key Features: Convenient Touch Controls & High-Temperature Sterilization The control panel is hidden at the top of the door via a touch interface, giving it a truly sleek appearance. You can intuitively select various options such as 'High Temperature Sterilization,' 'Extra Rinse,' and 'Powerful Drying.' Especially in times like these, the High Temperature Sterilization function, which sterilizes baby bottles and children's tableware by 99.9%, provides true peace of mind. Another major advantage is the 'Automatic Door Opening Drying' feature, which automatically opens the door after washing is finished, allowing you to dry dishes thoroughly without worrying about internal moisture or odors. With a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills has also been reduced. 3. Usage Tips & Finale: Dedicated Detergent Essential & Utilize SmartThings. To fully experience the dishwasher's performance, it is important to use the dedicated detergent. Using rinse aid along with it significantly improves drying performance and helps prevent water stains. Additionally, connecting the Samsung SmartThings app allows you to check the wash status or download cycles from outside, making it much more convenient to use. 4. Overall Review: This product lacks nothing in terms of design, performance, and convenience. I highly recommend it to those who want to reduce dishwashing time and increase time with their families. The Samsung BESPOKE Dishwasher will be a choice you truly won't regret!

A genuine review of the Samsung Bespoke 14-place setting dishwasher, purchased with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I finally installed the dishwasher I've been singing the praises of! After much deliberation, I chose the new Samsung BESPOKE 14-place setting built-in model (DW80H73Y1UZ). To start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. I hope my review helps those who are still deciding. 1. Pros: The Finishing Touch to Kitchen Interior & Perfect Cleaning Power The first thing that catches my eye is the design. Installed as a built-in unit to match my white kitchen, it looks incredibly clean. It fits in so snugly like custom-made furniture that it doesn't detract from the interior but rather adds a sophisticated touch. The soft mood lighting is also luxurious. Needless to say, the cleaning power is exceptional. Even without pre-washing, it washes away grease stains completely. (Check out the spacious interior and detailed wash guides!) Since it is a 14-place setting, large dishes like pots and pans fit comfortably, making it incredibly convenient. I feel liberated from the hell of dishwashing! 2. Key Features: Convenient Touch Controls & High-Temperature Sterilization The control panel is hidden at the top of the door via a touch interface, giving it a truly sleek appearance. You can intuitively select various options such as 'High Temperature Sterilization,' 'Extra Rinse,' and 'Powerful Drying.' Especially in times like these, the High Temperature Sterilization function, which sterilizes baby bottles and children's tableware by 99.9%, provides true peace of mind. Another major advantage is the 'Automatic Door Opening Drying' feature, which automatically opens the door after washing is finished, allowing you to dry dishes thoroughly without worrying about internal moisture or odors. With a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills has also been reduced. 3. Usage Tips & Finale: Dedicated Detergent Essential & Utilize SmartThings. To fully experience the dishwasher's performance, it is important to use the dedicated detergent. Using rinse aid along with it significantly improves drying performance and helps prevent water stains. Additionally, connecting the Samsung SmartThings app allows you to check the wash status or download cycles from outside, making it much more convenient to use. 4. Overall Review: This product lacks nothing in terms of design, performance, and convenience. I highly recommend it to those who want to reduce dishwashing time and increase time with their families. The Samsung BESPOKE Dishwasher will be a choice you truly won't regret!

A genuine review of the Samsung Bespoke 14-place setting dishwasher, purchased with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I finally installed the dishwasher I've been singing the praises of! After much deliberation, I chose the new Samsung BESPOKE 14-place setting built-in model (DW80H73Y1UZ). To start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. I hope my review helps those who are still deciding. 1. Pros: The Finishing Touch to Kitchen Interior & Perfect Cleaning Power The first thing that catches my eye is the design. Installed as a built-in unit to match my white kitchen, it looks incredibly clean. It fits in so snugly like custom-made furniture that it doesn't detract from the interior but rather adds a sophisticated touch. The soft mood lighting is also luxurious. Needless to say, the cleaning power is exceptional. Even without pre-washing, it washes away grease stains completely. (Check out the spacious interior and detailed wash guides!) Since it is a 14-place setting, large dishes like pots and pans fit comfortably, making it incredibly convenient. I feel liberated from the hell of dishwashing! 2. You can intuitively select various options such as 'High Temperature Sterilization,' 'Extra Rinse,' and 'Powerful Drying.' Especially in times like these, the High Temperature Sterilization function, which sterilizes baby bottles and children's tableware by 99.9%, provides true peace of mind. Another major advantage is the 'Automatic Door Opening Drying' feature, which automatically opens the door after washing is finished, allowing you to dry dishes thoroughly without worrying about internal moisture or odors. With a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating, the burden of electricity bills has also been reduced. 3. Usage Tips & Finale: Dedicated Detergent Essential & Utilize SmartThings. To fully experience the dishwasher's performance, it is important to use the dedicated detergent. Using rinse aid along with it significantly improves drying performance and helps prevent water stains. Additionally, connecting the Samsung SmartThings app allows you to check the wash status or download cycles from outside, making it much more convenient to use. 4. Overall Review: This product lacks nothing in terms of design, performance, and convenience. I highly recommend it to those who want to reduce dishwashing time and increase time with their families. The Samsung BESPOKE Dishwasher will be a choice you truly won't regret!

Sentence (English): Bought this dishwasher on 05/20 and used it exactly once.
Comments (English): Bought this dishwasher on 05/20 and used it exactly once. The next time I tried to use it - nothing. No lights, no sounds - it would not work at all. Following the required process, I scheduled a repair with GE which took 2 weeks to get on the schedule. The rep showed up and walked in with only a piece of paper. He told me the mother board was bad and that this was a common problem. He left after being there exactly 5 mins telling me the part would take 3-5 business days to come in and then the repair would be scheduled. Yesterday - 06/24 - GE called to tell me the part is on backorder and they have no idea when it will be in. I am now 5 weeks with a dishwasher I can't use. Even though there were very few 1 star reveiws, MANY of them mention this same issue. Unless you are a gambler, I wouldn't chance this one again.

Sentence (English): From reading a plethora of reviews for this dishwasher, I was confident and excited to procure one.
Comments (English): From reading a plethora of reviews for this dishwasher, I was confident and excited to procure one. Sadly, I'm very disappointed in the product. Pros first; It's very quiet . Cons; The cutlery rack configuration is wasteful and frustrating. The spaces for each piece of cutlery is too narrow and not spaced well. Loading this rack is much too laborious. The middle rack is my nemesis. Who ever designed this rack needs to go back to engineering school. Instead of creating a universal configuration, what was created was a specific use configuration. The majority of my dishes do not sit properly and loading is frustrating. The third rack while more universal in design, is terribly flimsy. I have also not found one location that adequately supports my coffee mugs. In terms of cleaning prowess, I'm old school and insure that the dishes loaded are relatively clean, so ipso facto they come out clean. What I have noticed, is that the rims of my coffee mugs require an additional rinsing. I purchased the model with drying component but it pales to any US brand with the same. The over feeling I have for this product is that "I'm stuck with it". Not a good emotion for an expensive purchase.

Sentence (English): From reading a plethora of reviews for this dishwasher, I was confident and excited to procure one.
Comments (English): From reading a plethora of reviews for this dishwasher, I was confident and excited to procure one. Sadly, I'm very disappointed in the product. Pros first; It's very quiet Cons; The cutlery rack configuration is wasteful and frustrating. The spaces for each piece of cutlery is too narrow and not spaced well. Loading this rack is much too laborious. The middle rack is my nemesis. Who ever designed this rack needs to go back to engineering school. Instead of creating a universal configuration, what was created was a specific use configuration. The majority of my dishes do not sit properly and loading is frustrating. The third rack while more universal in design, is terribly flimsy. I have also not found one location that adequately supports my coffee mugs. In terms of cleaning prowess, I'm old school and insure that the dishes loaded are relatively clean, so ipso facto they come out clean. What I have noticed, is that the rims of my coffee mugs require an additional rinsing. I purchased the model with drying component but it pales to any US brand with the same. The over feeling I have for this product is that "I'm stuck with it". Not a good emotion for an expensive purchase.

Sentence (English): I paid a lot of attention to the placement before ordering.
Comments (English): I paid a lot of attention to the placement before ordering. I measured the size of the sink countertop with a tape measure and thought about where to put it. I ruled out the right side of the sink because the faucet handle is on the right, so I thought it might bump into things or be inconvenient. Also, since a water purifier was already there, I would have had to move it, which would have been a hassle. Furthermore, placing the dishwasher to the left of the sink is much more convenient when pre-washing dishes, and I thought that space would be perfect for placing a cutting board when the dishwasher isn't in use. I also considered the possibility of water dripping from pre-washing when using the dishwasher, so I ordered a Pakuzen foldable silicone drying mat after installing the dishwasher. I drew a floor plan of the countertop, took photos of the kitchen space, consulted with AI, and carefully considered the options before finally settling on the perfect spot, which made me feel great. Two technicians from Samsung came directly for delivery; they were kind and installed everything very neatly. Since my countertop is engineered stone rather than artificial marble, I was already aware that I would have to pay a 100,000 won drilling fee on-site, so the installation was completed without any issues. I liked the dishwasher even more because it has a pretty design and doesn't feel like it takes up as much space as I expected, yet the interior is larger than I anticipated. I purchased the Digital Onnuri Gift Certificate via Naver Pay, so I downloaded the necessary documents after confirming the purchase and applied on Samsung.com. Since I can also receive the Onnuri gift certificate, I feel like I got a really good deal. I wrote this long review to encourage you to carefully consider the installation location before purchasing so you can use the product comfortably. Thank you for the great product.

Sentence (English): My old Bosch lasted 15+ years.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher is fine - HATE the app! ] || ---------------- || My old Bosch lasted 15+ years. Loved it. This dishwasher seems fine and I have high hopes it will go a long time. It washes dishes. It seems well built. I like the stainless interior, and it actually is more spacious than the old one. The silverware basket is too small, so I reused our old one. Otherwise it works fine. BUT the app almost made me return it. I always run it over night on delay, which you apparently can't do from the door panel anymore. Why? Its a dish washer, not the space shuttle. The app is an unnecessary complication just to wash dishes. Sometimes the dishwasher comes on at the right time, sometimes it doesn't. Sometimes the door opens at the end as it's supposed to, sometimes it doesn't. I'm sure somewhere in the 5 screens you have to click on I'm setting something wrong. The buttons and labels are far from intuitive. But really, who decided we needed an APP to WASH DISHES? Come on folks.
